title: A Spatial Localizer for Constituent-Resolved Exciton Wannier Functions
abstract: The internal electron-hole structure of excitons influences optical and electric-field responses. Exciton Wannier functions have recently provided a local real-space representation of exciton bands. Because excitons are composite quasiparticles, these Wannier functions can be characterized by both their center-of-mass location and the internal electron-hole dipole. Resolving this internal structure in real space requires simultaneously locating the constituent electron and hole coordinates. However, the projected electron and hole position operators generally do not commute, so simultaneous diagonalization of these positions is impossible: their noncommutativity precludes a common eigenbasis and imposes a state-dependent lower bound on the joint spread. Existing approaches localize a single average coordinate or a specific constituent coordinate, but generally do not construct a common exciton Wannier basis that maximally localizes both constituent coordinates. Here, we construct an ``exciton spatial localizer'': a single Hermitian operator that embeds the constituent position operators within a Clifford-algebra structure and returns exciton Wannier functions, maximally localized in their electron and hole coordinates simultaneously. Our formulation is ansatz-free, gauge-invariant, and applies to the generic multiband case. In an interacting bilayer model with an isolated group of exciton bands, we show that reflection and time-reversal symmetries, or other nonsymmorphic symmetries detailed herein, enforce a pointwise traceless but nonzero quantum geometric dipole matrix, which manifests in symmetry-related pairs of exciton Wannier functions with equal and opposite internal electron-hole dipoles.
summary:
激子的内部电子空穴结构影响光学和电场响应。激子万尼尔函数最近提供了激子带的局部实空间表示。由于激子是复合准粒子，因此这些万尼尔函数可以通过其质心位置和内部电子空穴偶极子来表征。在真实空间中解析这种内部结构需要同时定位组成的电子和空穴坐标。然而，投影的电子和空穴位置算子通常不会交换，因此这些位置的同时对角化是不可能的：它们的非交换性排除了共同的特征基，并对联合展开施加了依赖于状态的下界。现有方法定位单个平均坐标或特定成分坐标，但通常不构建最大程度定位两个成分坐标的公共激子万尼尔基。

在这里，我们构建了一个“激子空间定位器”：一个厄尔米特算子，它将组成位置算子嵌入到 Clifford 代数结构中，并返回激子 Wannier 函数，同时最大程度地定位在其电子和空穴坐标中。我们的公式是无拟定的、规范不变的，并且适用于通用的多频带情况。在具有一组孤立的激子带的相互作用双层模型中，我们表明反射和时间反转对称性或本文详细介绍的其他非对称对称性强制执行点状无痕但非零的量子几何偶极子矩阵，这表现为具有相等和相反的内部电子空穴偶极子的对称相关的激子万尼尔函数对。

title: Phase synchronization of fish schools through spatial gaps
abstract: We investigate how sensory coupling mediates phase coherence between spatially separated, confined active systems. Using two fish schools separated by a water-filled transparent gap, we isolate vision as the primary interaction channel. Under boundary confinement, each school's center-of-mass heading exhibits noisy bistable dynamics, spontaneously switching between two antiparallel directions along the partition wall. Turning events in one school bias the orientation of the other, driving distance-dependent phase synchronization. We model this behavior using two coupled stochastic bistable oscillators whose exact solution quantitatively reproduces the empirical results. Our work establishes a precise connection between nonequilibrium active systems and coupled stochastic oscillators, offering insight into boundary-spanning information transfer in living collectives.
summary: 我们研究感觉耦合如何介导空间分离的受限活动系统之间的相位相干性。使用由充满水的透明间隙隔开的两个鱼群，我们将视觉隔离为主要的互动渠道。在边界限制下，每所学校的质心方向都表现出嘈杂的双稳态动力学，沿着隔墙在两个反平行方向之间自发切换。一所学校的转向事件会偏向另一所学校的方向，从而驱动依赖于距离的相位同步。我们使用两个耦合的随机双稳态振荡器来模拟这种行为，其精确解定量地再现了经验结果。我们的工作在非平衡主动系统和耦合随机振荡器之间建立了精确的联系，为生命集体中跨越边界的信息传输提供了深入的见解。

title: Tuning Boron-Vacancy Qubit Coherence through Layer Number in hBN
abstract:
The negatively charged boron vacancy ($\VB$) in hexagonal boron nitride (\hBN{}) was the first optically addressable spin qubit identified inside a van der Waals crystal, allowing atomically defined placement relative to a target. Its coherence in bulk \hBN{} is limited by the boron nuclei of the layers flanking the defect plane, which a thin flake removes. Here, we use a generalized cluster-correlation expansion with an extended central-spin block to calculate the Hahn-echo coherence time of $\VB$ in h$^{11}$B$^{15}$N as a function of layer number. Our results show that $T_2$ rises from $199
s$ in the bulk limit to $653
s$ in a monolayer, a factor of $3.3$ that is already saturated at three layers and that a sublattice decomposition attributes entirely to boron. The enhancement is confined to low field, is insensitive to stacking registry and twist angle, and requires alignment to within about two degrees, an onset we reproduce with no free parameters. Under dynamical decoupling, a $1/e$ threshold returns $206
s$ for every thickness, but this is a zero of the first-shell modulation rather than a decay: measured without a threshold, the layer contrast survives and reaches a factor of $170$. Layer number thus emerges as a design parameter for $\VB$-based sensing.
summary:
六方氮化硼 (\hBN{}) 中带负电的硼空位 ($\VB$) 是范德华晶体内发现的第一个光学可寻址自旋量子位，允许相对于目标进行原子定义的放置。它在块体 \hBN{} 中的相干性受到缺陷平面两侧层的硼核的限制，薄薄片将缺陷平面去除。在这里，我们使用带有扩展中心自旋块的广义簇相关扩展来计算 h$^{11}$B$^{15}$N 中 $\VB$ 的哈恩回波相干时间作为层数的函数。我们的结果表明，$T_2$ 从体积限制中的 $199
s$ 上升到单层中的 $653
s$，系数为 $3.3$，在三层中已经饱和，并且亚晶格分解完全归因于硼。增强仅限于低场，对堆叠配准和扭转角度不敏感，并且需要在大约两度内对齐，这是我们在没有自由参数的情况下重现的开始。

在动态解耦下，$1/e$ 阈值对于每个厚度都会返回 $206
s$，但这是第一层调制的零而不是衰减：在没有阈值的情况下测量，层对比度仍然存在并达到 $170$ 的因子。因此，层数成为基于 $\VB$ 的传感的设计参数。

title: Symmetry-selective nonrelativistic spin splitting in antiferromagnets driven by coherent phonons
abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in antiferromagnets (AFMs) enables magnetization-free spin polarization for ultrafast spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that coherent phonons can dynamically induce and control NRSS in collinear AFMs. Excitation of $\Gamma$-point infrared-active phonons lifts the spin degeneracy of the ground state, while the residual sublattice-connecting symmetries determine the momentum-space form of the induced splitting. Because the relevant infrared modes couple to orthogonal in-plane light polarizations, distinct spin-split phases can be selectively activated by the polarization of the driving field. Using first-principles calculations for MnPS$_3$, we show that a mode that breaks all sublattice-connecting symmetries induces an $s$-wave spin-split state with $\Delta(\Gamma)\neq0$, whereas a symmetry-distinct mode that preserves a sublattice-connecting mirror symmetry generates a $d$-wave altermagnetic state with $\Delta(\Gamma)=0$. In both cases, the spin splitting grows linearly with the phonon amplitude and reverses the induced spin polarization when the displacement is reversed. Our results establish coherent lattice driving as a direct, polarization- and mode-selective route to dynamically induce distinct NRSS phases in AFMs.
summary:
反铁磁体 (AFM) 中的非相对论自旋分裂 (NRSS) 能够实现超快自旋电子学的无磁化自旋极化。在这里，我们证明相干声子可以动态地诱导和控制共线 AFM 中的 NRSS。 $\Gamma$点红外活性声子的激发提升了基态的自旋简并性，而剩余的亚晶格连接对称性决定了诱导分裂的动量空间形式。由于相关红外模式与正交面内光偏振耦合，因此可以通过驱动场的偏振选择性地激活不同的自旋分裂相。使用 MnPS$_3$ 的第一性原理计算，我们发现打破所有亚晶格连接对称性的模式会产生 $\Delta(\Gamma)\neq0$ 的 $s$ 波自旋分裂态，而保留亚晶格连接镜像对称性的对称性不同模式会产生 $\Delta(\Gamma)=0$ 的 $d$ 波交变磁态。在这两种情况下，自旋分裂随声子振幅线性增长，并在位移反向时反转诱导自旋极化。

我们的结果将相干晶格驱动建立为一种直接的、偏振和模式选择的途径，以在 AFM 中动态诱导不同的 NRSS 相位。

title: Machine Learning Local Potentials for Accelerated Electron-Phonon Interactions Calculations within the Projector Augmented-Wave Framework
abstract: Electron-phonon interactions govern carrier dynamics, transport, and many optical and quantum phenomena in solids, but finite-displacement calculations within the projector augmented-wave (PAW) framework require up to 6N self-consistent supercell calculations for an N-atom system, making them costly for large, low-symmetry, and disordered materials. We introduce MLLocP, a machine learning strategy that learns the self-consistent local potential on real-space grids and supplies its displacement derivatives to the evaluation of all-electron PAW electron-phonon matrix elements. Analysis of the PAW decomposition identifies the local-potential contribution as a natural target for machine learning, while the remaining PAW quantities are retained within the established VASP/PHELEL framework. Using targeted grid-point sampling and feature-diversity selection for efficient model training, we validate MLLocP for elemental Cu, polar BAs, and chemically disordered Cu3Au. The learned potentials and their resulting displacement derivatives closely reproduce direct density functional theory calculations, yielding transport coefficients within approximately 3.5% for BAs mobility, 8% for Cu conductivity, and 11% for Cu3Au conductivity. For the 32-atom Cu3Au special quasirandom structure, using 40 sampled configurations reduces the number of self-consistent calculations by about fivefold relative to the 192 displaced structures required directly; using 20 or 10 configurations increases the acceleration to approximately 10- and 20-fold, with conductivity errors of 14.3% and 18.6%, respectively. MLLocP thus provides a scalable route to PAW electron-phonon calculations in complex materials while preserving the underlying all-electron formalism.
summary:
电子-声子相互作用控制固体中的载流子动力学、输运以及许多光学和量子现象，但投影增强波 (PAW) 框架内的有限位移计算需要对 N 原子系统进行多达 6N 个自洽超晶胞计算，这使得大型、低对称性和无序材料的成本高昂。我们引入了 MLLoCP，这是一种机器学习策略，可以学习真实空间网格上的自洽局部势，并提供其位移导数来评估全电子 PAW 电子声子矩阵元素。 PAW 分解分析将局部潜在贡献确定为机器学习的自然目标，而剩余的 PAW 数量保留在已建立的 VASP/PHELEL 框架内。使用有针对性的网格点采样和特征多样性选择来进行有效的模型训练，我们验证了元素 Cu、极性 BA 和化学无序 Cu3Au 的 MLLocP。

学习到的电势及其产生的位移导数密切再现了直接密度泛函理论计算，得出的 BA 迁移率传输系数约为 3.5%，Cu 电导率约为 8%，Cu3Au 电导率约为 11%。对于32原子Cu3Au特殊准随机结构，使用40个采样配置相对于直接需要的192个位移结构减少了约五倍的自洽计算数量；使用 20 或 10 个配置将加速度增加到大约 10 倍和 20 倍，电导率误差分别为 14.3% 和 18.6%。因此，MLLoCP 为复杂材料中的 PAW 电子声子计算提供了一种可扩展的途径，同时保留了底层的全电子形式主义。

title: Microscopic dynamics of contagion using active Brownian particles: universal scaling and propagation controlled by protection
abstract: Understanding how individual protection and population density influence epidemic spreading remains a central challenge in epidemiology. While classical compartmental models successfully describe the temporal evolution of epidemics, they do not explicitly account for the microscopic motion and spatial organisation of individuals. Here, we investigate contagion dynamics using an agent-based model of Active Brownian Particles (ABPs), where self-propelled agents interact through local contact and a prescribed fraction of the population is protected. By systematically varying the protected-agent fraction and the population density, we identify two distinct contagion regimes separated by a crossover protection of approximately $30\%$. Below this threshold, the maximum contagion rate follows the universal scaling $\nu_{\mathrm{max}}\propto\phi^{1/2}$, indicating that disease transmission is governed primarily by frequency of encounters. Above the threshold, universal scaling is lost and protection becomes the dominant mechanism controlling epidemic spreading, with the strongest suppression occurring in low-density populations. These results demonstrate that microscopic active-matter models provide a powerful framework for investigating epidemic dynamics beyond the assumptions of well-mixed population models and reveal how spatial organisation and individual protection jointly determine contagion dynamics.
summary:
了解个人保护和人口密度如何影响流行病传播仍然是流行病学的一个核心挑战。虽然经典的区室模型成功地描述了流行病的时间演变，但它们没有明确解释个体的微观运动和空间组织。在这里，我们使用基于代理的活性布朗粒子（ABP）模型来研究传染动力学，其中自驱动代理通过局部接触进行相互作用，并且指定比例的人群受到保护。通过系统地改变受保护的个体比例和人口密度，我们确定了两种不同的传染机制，它们之间的交叉保护约为 30\%$。低于此阈值，最大传染率遵循通用标度 $\nu_{\mathrm{max}}\propto\phi^{1/2}$，表明疾病传播主要受相遇频率的影响。超过阈值，普遍规模就会丧失，保护成为控制流行病传播的主导机制，最强烈的抑制发生在低密度人群中。

这些结果表明，微观活性物质模型为研究流行病动态提供了一个强大的框架，超越了混合良好的人口模型的假设，并揭示了空间组织和个体保护如何共同决定传染动态。

title: Interaction effects on Andreev states from an electromagnetic environment
abstract: Here we present a detailed theoretical investigation of the environment-induced interaction correction to the ground states and addition energies in a short superconducting junction. We derive general formulas for these corrections linking them to the frequency-dependent admittance of the junction and the environment impedance. We specify two environmental models: that of an external impedance and the Mattis-Bardeen model. In both cases we assume $G_Q Z \ll 1$, where $G_Q$ is the conductance quantum and $Z$ the typical environmental resistance. While an expectation is that the typical scale of the relative correction is of the order $G_Q Z$, we have found that in many cases the dimensionless scale $L G_Q \Delta$ provides a better estimation, where $\Delta$ is the superconducting energy gap and $L$ an external inductance. We discuss the logarithmic renormalizations of the energies by low- and high-frequency phase fluctuations and single out a non-superconducting contribution related to the renormalization of transmission eigenvalues. We investigate in detail the peculiarities of the corrections at: i. small phases, where the interaction causes a current jump, ii. Andreev bound state energies close to the gap edge, iii. Andreev bound state energies close to Fermi level. In all these cases the correction may become comparable with the unperturbed energy, even for $G_Q Z \ll 1$, and we briefly sketch non-perturbative models relevant for the situations.
summary:
在这里，我们对短超导结中的基态和附加能量的环境引起的相互作用校正进行了详细的理论研究。我们推导出这些校正的通用公式，将它们与结点的频率相关导纳和环境阻抗联系起来。我们指定了两个环境模型：外部阻抗模型和 Mattis-Bardeen 模型。在这两种情况下，我们假设 $G_Q Z \ll 1$，其中 $G_Q$ 是电导量子，$Z$ 是典型的环境电阻。虽然预期相对校正的典型尺度为 $G_Q Z$ 量级，但我们发现在许多情况下，无量纲尺度 $L G_Q \Delta$ 提供了更好的估计，其中 $\Delta$ 是超导能隙，$L$ 是外部电感。我们讨论了低频和高频相位涨落对能量的对数重整化，并找出与传输特征值重整化相关的非超导贡献。我们详细研究了修正的特殊性：i．小阶段，其中相互作用导致电流跳跃，ii。

安德烈耶夫束缚态能量接近能隙边缘，iii。安德列夫束缚态能量接近费米能级。在所有这些情况下，即使对于 $G_Q Z \ll 1$，校正也可能与未扰动的能量相当，并且我们简要地勾勒出与情况相关的非扰动模型。

title: Non-Additivity of Microwave-Shielded Interactions between Dipolar Molecules
abstract: Theoretical models of the effective interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules typically rely on the assumption of pairwise additivity. In this work, we test the validity of this pairwise approximation by evaluating the exact many-body potential energy for configurations of three and four molecules. We demonstrate that this approximation fails for molecule configurations in the plane of the circularly polarized microwave field. In these planar geometries, many-body effects significantly increase the depth of the attractive potential well and shift the position of the repulsive barrier. Although out-of-plane interactions in three-dimensional arrangements weaken this non-additivity, the effective interactions between microwave-shielded dipoles are not a simple sum of pair interactions. In particular, their attractive well, crucial for self-bound clusters, can only be described by the full many-body potential energy.
summary: 微波屏蔽极性分子之间有效相互作用的理论模型通常依赖于成对加和性的假设。在这项工作中，我们通过评估三个和四个分子构型的精确多体势能来测试这种成对近似的有效性。我们证明这种近似对于圆偏振微波场平面中的分子构型是失败的。在这些平面几何形状中，多体效应显着增加了吸引势阱的深度并改变了排斥势垒的位置。尽管三维排列中的面外相互作用削弱了这种非可加性，但微波屏蔽偶极子之间的有效相互作用并不是对相互作用的简单总和。特别是，它们的吸引力井对于自束缚团簇至关重要，只能用完整的多体势能来描述。

title: Observation of g-wave altermagnetic multipole
abstract: Over the past few years, altermagnets have emerged as a new class of collinear magnets with broken time-reversal symmetry, offering novel opportunities for spintronics beyond conventional magnets. Rather than from net magnetization, as in ferromagnets, the unconventional time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets originates from antiferroic magnetic dipoles locked to higher-order multipoles. Here we report the direct visualization of a $g$-wave altermagnetic multipole in the canonical altermagnet CrSb. Combining high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction with valence electron density (VED) analysis, we uncover a pronounced directional anisotropy of the VED distribution alternating between Cr sublattices. This evidences the antiferroic order of electric hexadecapoles predicted in $g$-wave altermagnets. Its coexistence with antiferroic magnetic dipoles induces ferroic magnetic multipoles, as probed by polarized neutron diffraction. We further identify a microscopic model of altermagnetism that directly relates the $g$-wave multipole and the $g$-wave spin splitting. Through direct observation and quantification of multipoles, this study provides a real-space fingerprint of altermagnetism and establishes a general probe of hidden multipole order in quantum materials.
summary:
在过去的几年里，交替磁体已经成为一种新型共线磁体，其时间反转对称性被打破，为自旋电子学提供了超越传统磁体的新机遇。与铁磁体中的净磁化强度不同，交流磁体的非常规时间反转对称性破缺源自锁定到高阶多极的反铁磁偶极子。在这里，我们报告了规范交变磁体 CrSb 中 $g$ 波交变磁多极的直接可视化。结合高能同步加速器 X 射线衍射与价电子密度 (VED) 分析，我们发现了 Cr 亚晶格之间交替的 VED 分布的明显方向各向异性。这证明了$g$波交变磁体中预测的电十六极的反铁序。正如偏振中子衍射所探测到的，它与反铁磁偶极子的共存会引起铁磁多极子。我们进一步确定了交变磁力的微观模型，该模型直接将 $g$ 波多极子和 $g$ 波自旋分裂联系起来。

通过对多极子的直接观察和量化，这项研究提供了交变磁性的真实空间指纹，并建立了量子材料中隐藏多极子序的通用探针。

title: Symmetry-enforced third-order nonlinear thermal Hall effects in altermagnets
abstract: Thermal Hall effect (THE) is a powerful probe of material properties, even in insulators. Here we investigate the thermal response of altermagnets by developing a theory on Berry curvature driven nonlinear THE from both electrons and magnons. We identify symmetry conditions under which the third-order THE dominates while linear and second-order contributions vanish. Notably, d-wave and i-wave altermagnets with out-of-plane Neel order satisfy these conditions, whereas in-plane order yields a dominant linear THE. Using KV2Se2O (a d-wave altermagnetic metal) and MnF2 (an altermagnetic insulator) as concrete examples, we show nonzero third-order nonlinear THE from electrons and magnons, respectively, both exhibiting a pi-periodic dependence on the direction of temperature gradient. These symmetry-guaranteed Berry curvature phenomena provide a diagnostic for altermagnetism in candidate materials and enable determination of the Neel vector orientation.
summary: 热霍尔效应 (THE) 是一种强大的材料特性探测工具，即使在绝缘体中也是如此。在这里，我们通过发展一种由电子和磁子驱动的非线性 THE 的贝里曲率理论来研究交变磁体的热响应。我们确定了三阶 THE 占主导地位而线性和二阶贡献消失的对称条件。值得注意的是，具有面外尼尔序的 d 波和 i 波交替磁体满足这些条件，而面内序则产生占主导地位的线性 THE。使用 KV2Se2O（一种 d 波交变磁金属）和 MnF2（一种交变磁绝缘体）作为具体例子，我们分别展示了来自电子和磁振子的非零三阶非线性 THE，两者都表现出对温度梯度方向的 pi 周期依赖性。这些对称性保证的贝里曲率现象为候选材料中的交变磁性提供了诊断，并能够确定尼尔矢量方向。

title: Bell inequality violation with momentum-entangled massive particles
abstract: Bell's theorem revealed the fundamental incompatibility between the predictions of quantum mechanics and local realism. Bell inequality violations have since demonstrated quantum nonlocality using photons and internal states of massive particles, but never using their motional states. Here we report the first Bell inequality violation in the motional states of massive particles. Using momentum-entangled pairs of metastable helium atoms manipulated by matter-wave interferometry, we measure a Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) Bell parameter of $S = 2.52 \pm 0.17$, violating the CHSH-Bell inequality ($S \le 2$). Our work completes a long-standing objective in quantum atom optics by extending Bell tests from internal quantum variables to the external degrees of freedom of massive particles, opening a new regime for exploring quantum nonlocality in matter waves and for investigating the interplay between quantum mechanics and gravity.
summary: 贝尔定理揭示了量子力学的预测与局域实在论之间根本上的不相容。此后，贝尔不等式的违反证明了使用光子和大质量粒子的内部状态的量子非定域性，但从未使用它们的运动状态。在这里，我们报告了大质量粒子运动状态中的第一个贝尔不等式违规。利用物质波干涉测量操纵的动量纠缠亚稳态氦原子对，我们测量了克劳瑟-霍恩-希莫尼-霍尔特 (CHSH) 贝尔参数 $S = 2.52 \pm 0.17$，违反了 CHSH-贝尔不等式 ($S \le 2$)。我们的工作通过将贝尔测试从内部量子变量扩展到大质量粒子的外部自由度，完成了量子原子光学的长期目标，为探索物质波中的量子非定域性以及研究量子力学和引力之间的相互作用开辟了新的领域。

title: Complete Topological Classification with P and T Symmetries: Revealing a Topological Invariant Invisible to K-Theory
abstract: The K-theoretic framework provides a complete topological classification of the tenfold symmetry classes and has been generalized to incorporate crystalline symmetries. Here, we show that this classification is incomplete even in the elementary case of spinless systems possessing both P and T symmetries. We obtain the complete classification through a first-principles analysis of the topological classes of P- and T-symmetric bands, namely, by classifying the corresponding symmetric clutching data. We identify a topological invariant that is invisible from the K-theoretic perspective when the occupied states at each inversion-invariant momentum have uniformly positive or uniformly negative parity. In special cases, such as when all inversion-invariant momenta have uniformly positive parity, this invariant can be interpreted as the second Stiefel--Whitney class or the Euler number defined over an inversion fundamental domain, namely, half of the Brillouin zone. Our work not only reveals a new topological invariant that cannot be determined from the parity spectra at inversion-invariant momenta under P and T symmetries, but also demonstrates the existence of crystalline topological phases that are absent from the K-theoretic classification.
summary:
K 理论框架提供了十重对称类别的完整拓扑分类，并已推广到包含晶体对称性。在这里，我们证明即使在同时具有 P 和 T 对称性的无自旋系统的基本情况下，这种分类也是不完整的。我们通过对 P 对称带和 T 对称带的拓扑类进行第一性原理分析，即对相应的对称抓取数据进行分类，获得完整的分类。当每个反演不变动量的占据态具有一致正或一致负宇称时，我们确定了从 K 理论角度看不到的拓扑不变量。在特殊情况下，例如当所有反演不变动量都具有一致的正宇称时，该不变量可以解释为第二 Stiefel-Whitney 类或在反演基本域（即布里渊区的一半）上定义的欧拉数。

我们的工作不仅揭示了一个新的拓扑不变量，该不变量无法从 P 和 T 对称下的反演不变动量的宇称谱中确定，而且还证明了 K 理论分类中不存在的晶体拓扑相的存在。

title: The Locality Cost of Fully Flat Hopf Insulators
abstract: Hopf topology permits a strictly finite-range Hamiltonian with one exactly flat topological band. We prove, however, that extending flatness to the complete two-band spectrum necessarily sacrifices strict locality or the gap: any gapped, Hermitian, translationally invariant two-band Hamiltonian with strictly finite-range hopping and two exactly flat bands has vanishing Hopf invariant. Equivalently, within this two-band setting, a Hopf band admits no compactly supported, translation-covariant, orthonormal Wannier generator. For factorized one-flat-band Hopf parents, the unavoidable partner dispersion equals the Gram symbol of translated compact localized states and encodes their nonorthogonality. Full flattening converts this dispersion into exponentially decaying but infinitely supported hopping. Model-independent bounds provide a sufficient criterion for finite-range approximants to retain the Hopf phase. An explicit model yields the axial decay length $\xi_z/a=1/\ln 2$, parameter-free hopping tails, and residual bandwidths testable in circuit and photonic lattices. Hopf topology therefore does not prohibit a flat band but forces the locality--flatness cost to appear as either partner-band dispersion or nonlocal hopping.
summary:
Hopf 拓扑允许严格有限范围的哈密顿量具有一个完全平坦的拓扑带。然而，我们证明，将平坦度扩展到完整的两带谱必然会牺牲严格的局部性或间隙：任何具有严格有限范围跳跃和两个完全平坦带的有间隙、埃尔米特、平移不变的两带哈密顿量都具有消失的霍普夫不变量。同样，在这个双频带设置中，Hopf 带不允许紧支持的平移协变正交 Wannier 生成器。对于因式分解的单平带 Hopf 父母，不可避免的伙伴色散等于翻译的紧凑局域状态的 Gram 符号，并对其非正交性进行编码。完全平坦化将这种分散转化为指数衰减但无限支持的跳跃。与模型无关的边界为有限范围近似提供了保留 Hopf 相位的充分标准。显式模型产生轴向衰减长度 $\xi_z/a=1/\ln 2$、无参数跳变尾部以及可在电路和光子晶格中测试的剩余带宽。

因此，Hopf 拓扑并不禁止平坦频带，而是强制局部性平坦度成本表现为伙伴频带色散或非局部跳频。

title: Vortex-core Majorana coupling to a chiral edge in a $p_x+ip_y$ superconductor: Nonmonotonic spectral reorganization and coherent fermion-parity dynamics
abstract: We study how vortex--edge coupling reorganizes the low-energy sector of a finite two-dimensional \(p_x+ip_y\) superconducting disk as a function of the vortex--boundary separation \(d\) and examine what this reorganization implies for the parity memory associated with a prescribed vortex-core Majorana wave packet, a resource relevant to Majorana-based quantum operations. Bogoliubov--de Gennes calculations reveal nonmonotonic core--edge reorganization of the lowest positive-energy finite-disk eigenstate, with particularly rapid variation near \(d\simeq7\xi\), where \(\xi\) is the coherence length. To separate this eigenstate reorganization from the spectral representation of a prescribed state, we rigidly translate a centered-vortex core-reference packet to each fixed vortex position, restrict it to the target disk, and project it, without intermediate normalization, onto the particle-hole-complete low-energy subspace. For \(\Delta_0/E_F=0.36\) and disk radius \(R=30\xi\), the resulting retained norm exceeds \(0.98\) at all six sampled separations, \(4.25\leq d/\xi\leq8.25\), while, depending on \(d\), the spectral measure is concentrated near zero energy, fragmented over several low-energy levels, or dominated by finite-energy weight. Correspondingly, the signed parity correlator displays slow temporal variation, rapid coherent dephasing, or sign-changing oscillations, with possible finite-size recurrences at later times. Thus a large retained norm does not by itself imply spectral concentration or persistent parity memory.
summary:
我们研究涡旋边缘耦合如何将有限二维\(p_x+ip_y\)超导盘的低能扇区重组为涡旋边界分离\(d\)的函数，并研究这种重组对于与指定涡核马约拉纳波包相关的奇偶校验存储器意味着什么，这是与基于马约拉纳的量子操作相关的资源。 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 计算揭示了最低正能量有限盘本征态的非单调核-边重组，在 \(d\simeq7\xi\) 附近变化特别快，其中 \(\xi\) 是相干长度。为了将这种本征态重组与规定状态的光谱表示分开，我们严格地将中心涡旋核心参考包平移到每个固定涡旋位置，将其限制在目标盘上，并将其投影到粒子空穴完全低能子空间上，而无需中间归一化。

对于 \(\Delta_0/E_F=0.36\) 和圆盘半径 \(R=30\xi\)，在所有六个采样间隔 \(4.25\leq d/\xi\leq8.25\) 处得到的保留范数超过 \(0.98\)，而根据 \(d\)，光谱测量集中在零能量附近，在几个低能级上分散，或者由有限能量权重主导。相应地，带符号的奇偶校验相关器表现出缓慢的时间变化、快速的相干移相或符号变化振荡，并在以后的时间可能出现有限大小的重复。因此，大的保留范数本身并不意味着频谱集中或持久的奇偶校验记忆。

title: Vitrification-Devitrification Enables Tunable Photonic and Gas Sorption Properties of Zeolitic Imidazolate Frameworks
abstract: Zeolitic imidazolate framework (ZIF) glasses represent an emerging family of melt-quenched glasses, which exhibit immense potential for applications in gas separation, energy storage, and optics. However, their intrinsic porosity remains elusive due to the inherent challenges in resolving their disordered atomistic structures. Here, we systematically investigate the porosity of ZIF-4 and ZIF-62 crystals and their corresponding glasses. CO2 sorption at 195 K enables quantitative assessment of microporosity in both crystalline and glassy states, allowing the accessible micropore volume of the ZIF glasses to be determined. Moreover, establishing a direct relationship between photonic properties and structural porosity in Zn-based ZIF glasses remains challenging. Here we demonstrate striking broadband blue-light emission from ZIF-4 glass annealed under optimized conditions. A pronounced red shift is observed when increasing the annealing temperature above the glass transition temperature. By correlating the evolution of photoluminescence with structural porosity, we reveal the interplay between the photonic and gas sorption properties of ZIF glasses. These findings provide new insights into the structure-property relationships of ZIF glasses and offer a pathway toward the rational design of multifunctional MOF glasses.
summary:
沸石咪唑酯骨架 (ZIF) 玻璃代表了一个新兴的熔融淬火玻璃系列，在气体分离、能量存储和光学领域展现出巨大的应用潜力。然而，由于解决其无序原子结构的固有挑战，它们的内在孔隙率仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们系统地研究了 ZIF-4 和 ZIF-62 晶体及其相应玻璃的孔隙率。 195 K 下的 CO2 吸附能够定量评估结晶态和玻璃态的微孔率，从而确定 ZIF 玻璃的可接近微孔体积。此外，在锌基 ZIF 玻璃中建立光子特性和结构孔隙率之间的直接关系仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了在优化条件下退火的 ZIF-4 玻璃的惊人宽带蓝光发射。当将退火温度提高到玻璃化转变温度以上时，会观察到明显的红移。通过将光致发光的演变与结构孔隙率联系起来，我们揭示了 ZIF 玻璃的光子和气体吸附特性之间的相互作用。

这些发现为ZIF玻璃的结构-性能关系提供了新的见解，并为多功能MOF玻璃的合理设计提供了途径。

title: Nonequilibrium corrections to conserved Ising criticality in scalar active matter: Ward identities, spectrum, and long crossovers
abstract: Active scalar field theories break detailed balance in two physically distinct ways: through a field-dependent noise-to-mobility ratio $\Theta(\phi)=D(\phi)/M(\phi)$, and through the gradient activity of Active Model~B+. We classify the resulting perturbations of the conserved Wilson-Fisher fixed point in three dimensions. Working from the Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De~Dominicis (MSRJD) action, a functional renormalization-group (FRG) calculation shows that the transport sector has a block-triangular stability matrix whose leading odd mode has $y_{\Theta_1}=-\Delta_\phi$, while quotienting the gradient sector by its detailed-balance-preserving tangent leaves a chemical and a current-like mode. Two smooth regulators give $y_{\Theta_1}\simeq-0.52$, $y_J\simeq-0.56$ and $y_{\rm ch}\simeq-0.89$. The translation Ward identity represents the current operator by a stress-tensor divergence modulo chemical gradients; conservation and causality then make the active stability matrix triangular to all loop orders, and an explicit two-loop calculation in $d=4-\epsilon$ finds no additional contact counterterm. The two slowest modes are separated only by the Ising anomalous dimension, $y_J-y_{\Theta_1}=-\eta$. This relation is a dimension count that holds provided neither operator acquires a further contact anomaly, a condition we establish within the present truncation for $\mathcal O_\Theta$ and verify through two loops for $\mathcal O_J$; under it the $d=3$ reference Ising value gives $y_{\Theta_1}\simeq-0.5181$ and $y_J\simeq-0.5544$. We derive the parity-resolved finite-size scaling of this near degeneracy, identify block observables that separate the two modes, and show that when the current amplitude dominates the crossover scale lies far beyond any accessible system size.
summary:
主动标量场理论以两种物理上不同的方式打破了详细的平衡：通过场相关的噪声与迁移率之比$\Theta(\phi)=D(\phi)/M(\phi)$，以及通过主动模型~B+的梯度活动。我们在三个维度上对守恒威尔逊-费舍尔不动点产生的扰动进行分类。根据 Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De~Dominicis (MSRJD) 作用，函数重正化群 (FRG) 计算表明，运输部门具有块三角稳定矩阵，其主导奇模为 $y_{\Theta_1}=-\Delta_\phi$，同时通过其详细平衡保持切线对梯度部门进行引用，留下化学模和类电流模。两个平滑调节器给出 $y_{\Theta_1}\simeq-0.52$、$y_J\simeq-0.56$ 和 $y_{\rm ch}\simeq-0.89$。平移 Ward 恒等式通过应力张量散度模化学梯度表示当前算子；然后，守恒定律和因果关系使主动稳定性矩阵与所有循环阶数成三角关系，并且 $d=4-\epsilon$ 中的显式二循环计算没有发现任何额外的接触反项。

两个最慢的模式仅由伊辛反常维度 $y_J-y_{\Theta_1}=-\eta$ 分开。这个关系是一个维度计数，只要两个操作员都没有获得进一步的接触异常，我们就在 $\mathcal O_\Theta$ 的当前截断中建立一个条件，并通过 $\mathcal O_J$ 的两个循环进行验证；在其下，$d=3$ 参考 Ising 值给出 $y_{\Theta_1}\simeq-0.5181$ 和 $y_J\simeq-0.5544$。我们推导了这种近简并性的奇偶解析有限尺寸标度，识别了分离两种模式的块可观测量，并表明当电流幅度占主导地位时，交叉标度远远超出任何可访问的系统尺寸。

title: Effect of reactive targets on diffusive transport with intermittent restarts
abstract: We study search processes in a complex environment using the strategy of stochastic resetting. A common occurrence in these environments is targets with finite reactivity. Stochastic resetting has emerged as a powerful mechanism for optimizing search processes by curtailing long, unproductive excursions inherent to diffusive dynamics. Most theoretical studies, however, assume perfectly absorbing targets -- an idealization that overlooks the finite reactivity commonly encountered in realistic chemical and biological systems. In this work, we investigate the interplay between stochastic resetting and finite-target reactivity in reaction - diffusion processes. Considering a one-dimensional system with multiple reactive targets, we demonstrated that the target reactivity modifies the optimization landscape. We uncover distinct regimes in which resetting enhances transport efficiency towards specific targets based on their chemical kinetics. As a consequence, the optimal resetting rate becomes intrinsically reactivity dependent. Our results identify target reactivity as a crucial control parameter governing stochastic transport and provide insights into reaction-diffusion processes in complex media.
summary:
我们使用随机重置策略来研究复杂环境中的搜索过程。这些环境中常见的情况是目标反应性有限。随机重置已成为一种强大的机制，通过减少扩散动力学固有的长时间、非生产性的偏移来优化搜索过程。然而，大多数理论研究都假设目标是完美吸收的——这是一种理想化，忽略了现实化学和生物系统中常见的有限反应性。在这项工作中，我们研究了反应扩散过程中随机重置和有限目标反应性之间的相互作用。考虑具有多个反应性目标的一维系统，我们证明了目标反应性会改变优化景观。我们发现了不同的机制，其中重置根据其化学动力学提高了针对特定目标的运输效率。因此，最佳重置速率本质上取决于反应性。

我们的结果将目标反应性确定为控制随机传输的关键控制参数，并为复杂介质中的反应扩散过程提供了见解。

title: Collective Cell Fluidity Controls Active Prestress Transmission in Cell-Extracellular-Matrix Tissues
abstract: Tissues are active composites in which multicellular collectives and extracellular matrices mechanically reorganize one another. We develop a three-dimensional micromechanical model that couples deformable, rearranging cell clusters to a disordered network of semiflexible fibers through a dynamic, force-generating interface. Cell clusters are represented as solid-like or fluid-like vertex-model spheroids and coupled to the matrix by passive or contractile linkers renewed as the cluster boundary reorganizes. Matched intact, voided, and passive-linker controls separate cavity formation, interfacial tethering, and active loading. At small strain, passive tethering provides modest reinforcement, whereas active contraction prestresses and strongly stiffens the matrix. Solid-like clusters preserve coherent force transmission and exhibit an excess modulus scaling approximately as $|\sigma|^{1.4}$ across changes in activity, cluster size, and cluster number. Fluid-like clusters undergo greater interfacial renewal, producing weaker and nonmonotonic coupling between prestress and stiffness. Increasing cluster number produces collective stiffening when prestressed regions become connected through sufficiently persistent interfaces. At large strain, both solid-like and fluid-like systems approach the corresponding voided-network response as the residual fiber backbone becomes mechanically dominant. Thus, cell-generated prestress controls macroscopic stiffness only together with the organization and persistence of its transmission across the cell-matrix interface.
summary:
组织是活性复合材料，其中多细胞集合体和细胞外基质彼此机械重组。我们开发了一种三维微机械模型，通过动态的力生成界面将可变形、重新排列的细胞簇与半柔性纤维的无序网络耦合起来。细胞簇被表示为类固体或类流体顶点模型球体，并通过随着簇边界重组而更新的被动或收缩连接体与基质耦合。匹配的完整、空洞和被动连接体控制单独的空腔形成、界面束缚和主动加载。在小应变下，被动束缚提供适度的加固，而主动收缩则预应力并强烈强化基质。类固体簇保持相干力传递，并在活动、簇大小和簇数量变化时表现出大约 $|\sigma|^{1.4}$ 的过量模量缩放。类流体簇经历更大的界面更新，在预应力和刚度之间产生较弱且非单调的耦合。

当预应力区域通过足够持久的界面连接时，增加簇数量会产生集体刚化。在大应变下，类固体和类流体系统都接近相应的空隙网络响应，因为残余纤维主干在机械上占主导地位。因此，细胞产生的预应力仅与其在细胞-基质界面上的传输的组织和持久性一起控制宏观刚度。

title: Molecular-dynamics-based modal analysis of heat transport in quasi-one-dimensional systems from a symmetry-adapted perspective
abstract: Detailed analysis of thermal conductivity results obtained from molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories conventionally relies on knowledge of the harmonic vibrational modes of the system. Such is the case in methods like Green--Kubo modal analysis (GKMA) and homogeneous nonequilibrium modal analysis (HNEMA). This approach faces several shortcomings that become especially important when dealing with nanostructures. Chief among them is scalability, followed by the ambiguity associated to the degeneracy of the large vibrational subspaces defined by a common translational wave number k. We propose an alternative for quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) systems: we construct the modal basis for the decomposition of the thermal conductivity from line-group projection operators, so that every projected component carries well-defined symmetry labels (including rotational information and parities) and the decomposition is unique at the level of irreducible representations (irreps). Applying the idea to a (10,0)-(20,0) WS2-MoS2 double-walled nanotube (DWNT) described by a neuroevolution potential (NEP), we find that at 300 K both HNEMA and GKMA yield statistically consistent total conductivities and allow the identification of several prominent symmetry-adapted conduction channels. The GKMA pair matrix shows that within-block and same-channel cross-k terms account for 75.6% of the total conductivity, while cross-channel correlations contribute 24.4%.
summary:
从分子动力学 (MD) 轨迹获得的热导率结果的详细分析通常依赖于系统简谐振动模式的知识。 Green-Kubo 模态分析 (GKMA) 和齐次非平衡模态分析 (HNEMA) 等方法就是这种情况。这种方法面临着几个缺点，这些缺点在处理纳米结构时变得尤为重要。其中最主要的是可扩展性，其次是与由公共平移波数 k 定义的大振动子空间的简并性相关的模糊性。我们提出了准一维（quasi-1D）系统的替代方案：我们构建了线群投影算子热导率分解的模态基础，以便每个投影组件都带有明确定义的对称标签（包括旋转信息和奇偶校验），并且分解在不可约表示（irreps）级别上是唯一的。

将这一想法应用于由神经进化电位 (NEP) 描述的 (10,0)-(20,0) WS2-MoS2 双壁纳米管 (DWNT)，我们发现在 300 K 时，HNEMA 和 GKMA 都产生统计上一致的总电导率，并允许识别几个突出的对称适应传导通道。 GKMA 对矩阵显示，块内和同通道跨 k 项占总电导率的 75.6%，而跨通道相关性贡献 24.4%。

title: Chemical pressure and vacancies in crystals under nonhydrostatic stress
abstract: Inhomogeneous stress is a driving force for diffusion of vacancies in crystals. The other way around a non-uniform distribution of vacancies induces stress. The accepted theory of composition-stress coupling in crystals is Larché-Cahn (LC) theory. Composition is defined in terms of the population of lattice sites with a limit of one-particle per site. Coupling is modelled by adding a compositional strain term to the elastic strain in the constitutive relation for stress. An alternative mechanism, proposed here, is letting the site binding energy vary with spatial (deformed) density. This generates a chemical pressure adding to the elastic stress. The governing equations for this model are derived using non-equilibrium continuum thermodynamic methods. The gradient of the chemical pressure has a dual function acting both as the drift force for migration and as an effective internal one body force in the Cauchy equation for the elastic stress. The practical evaluation presented in the paper is restricted to equilibrium properties. We examine the effect of externally applied non-hydrostatic stress, either in the form of surface tractions or a one-body force density (gravitation). The model system is a one component crystal with a fixed number of lattice sites. The number of particles can be variable but is always smaller than the number of lattice sites. The linear elastic response is modelled by the standard Lamé stress tensor. The results for systems deformed by surface tractions are in qualitative agreement with LC theory allowing for differences in the expression for the elastic moduli. Deviations are more serious for the crystal deformed by gravitation.
summary:
不均匀应力是晶体中空位扩散的驱动力。另一方面，职位空缺分布不均匀也会产生压力。晶体中成分-应力耦合的公认理论是 Larché-Cahn (LC) 理论。组成是根据晶格位点的数量来定义的，每个位点仅限一个粒子。通过在应力本构关系中的弹性应变中添加复合应变项来对耦合进行建模。这里提出的另一种机制是让位点结合能随着空间（变形）密度而变化。这会产生化学压力，增加弹性应力。该模型的控制方程是使用非平​​衡连续介质热力学方法导出的。化学压力的梯度具有双重功能，既充当迁移的漂移力，又充当弹性应力的柯西方程中的有效内部一体力。本文提出的实际评估仅限于平衡特性。我们研究外部施加的非静水应力的影响，无论是表面牵引力还是单体力密度（重力）的形式。

该模型系统是具有固定数量晶格位置的单组分晶体。粒子的数量可以是可变的，但总是小于晶格位点的数量。线弹性响应由标准 Lamé 应力张量建模。考虑到弹性模量表达式的差异，表面牵引变形系统的结果与 LC 理论定性一致。对于因重力而变形的晶体，偏差更为严重。

title: Thermodynamic Electric Toroidal Dipole and Intrinsic Longitudinal Spin Transport
abstract: Electric toroidal dipoles (ETDs) characterize ferroaxial order, yet their bulk definition in periodic crystals has remained elusive because conventional multipole operators involve the ill-defined position operator. Here we formulate a thermodynamic ETD by coupling a spatially varying electric field to the relativistic spin-induced electric polarization. The resulting expression is gauge invariant and provides a bulk order parameter for ferroaxial phases. We further establish a direct relation between the chemical-potential derivative of the ETD and the intrinsic longitudinal spin conductivity in insulating systems. To demonstrate the formulation, we construct a minimal ferroaxial extension of the Kane--Mele model. The ETD becomes finite exclusively in the ferroaxial phase and is strongly enhanced near a small band gap, accompanied by a sizable longitudinal spin current. Our results establish a thermodynamic theory of ETDs in crystalline solids and identify the longitudinal spin conductivity as a direct transport manifestation of ferroaxial order.
summary: 电环形偶极子（ETD）表征了铁轴序，但它们在周期性晶体中的整体定义仍然难以捉摸，因为传统的多极算子涉及定义不明确的位置算子。在这里，我们通过将空间变化的电场与相对论自旋引起的电极化耦合来制定热力学 ETD。所得表达式是规范不变的，并为铁轴相提供了批量有序参数。我们进一步建立了 ETD 的化学势导数与绝缘系统中固有的纵向自旋电导率之间的直接关系。为了演示该公式，我们构建了 Kane-Mele 模型的最小铁轴延伸。 ETD 仅在铁轴相中变得有限，并且在小带隙附近强烈增强，并伴随着相当大的纵向自旋电流。我们的结果建立了晶体固体中 ETD 的热力学理论，并将纵向自旋电导率确定为铁轴有序的直接输运表现。

title: Impedance in Periodically Driven Stochastic Systems
abstract: We study the time-dependent currents arising in periodically driven stochastic systems. In the linear regime of small driving, a closed expression is obtained for the impedance/admittance associated with these currents. This expression leads directly to an interpretation in terms of an equivalent electrical circuit. For a stochastic system with $N$ states, the electrical circuit consists of precisely $N$ parallel branches, with each branch comprising a resistor and a capacitor in series. The low- and high-frequency limits of these currents are calculated, and the results are generalized to more general current expressions. We demonstrate our findings across several archetypal settings, illustrating the potential to detect specific broken symmetries or the graph topology associated with the stochastic process.
summary: 我们研究周期性驱动的随机系统中产生的随时间变化的电流。在小驱动的线性区域中，获得与这些电流相关的阻抗/导纳的闭合表达式。该表达式直接导致等效电路的解释。对于具有 $N$ 状态的随机系统，电路由精确的 $N$ 并联分支组成，每个分支包含串联的电阻器和电容器。计算这些电流的低频和高频极限，并将结果推广到更通用的电流表达式。我们在几种原型设置中展示了我们的发现，说明了检测特定破缺对称性或与随机过程相关的图拓扑的潜力。

title: 'pySNOW': a Python Suite for the NanO-World
abstract: In computational materials science, numerical simulations are indispensable tools for revealing atomic-scale processes. For building blocks of the nanoworld, such as nanoparticles and nanoalloys, atomistic simulations provide detailed insight into their behaviour under diverse conditions. These simulations enable the study of formation and growth mechanisms, transport phenomena, chemophysical stability, and chemical reactions, including catalytic processes. To unravel the complex structure--property relationships that characterise nanoobjects, it is crucial to develop robust and insightful representations of their atomistic structure at global and local scales. Such descriptions enhance our understanding of nanoparticle behaviour and play a key role in guiding their rational design in silico for targeted applications.
summary: 在计算材料科学中，数值模拟是揭示原子尺度过程不可或缺的工具。对于纳米世界的构建模块，例如纳米颗粒和纳米合金，原子模拟可以详细了解它们在不同条件下的行为。这些模拟可以研究形成和生长机制、传输现象、化学物理稳定性和化学反应，包括催化过程。为了揭示纳米物体的复杂结构-性质关系，在全局和局部尺度上开发其原子结构的稳健且富有洞察力的表示至关重要。这些描述增强了我们对纳米颗粒行为的理解，并在指导其针对目标应用的合理计算机设计方面发挥了关键作用。

title: Branching stochastic mechanics. II. Relative localization and collective poles from Bohm/Fisher feedback
abstract: Paper I introduced branching stochastic mechanics (BSM) by lifting the Schrödinger-Nagasawa pair to reciprocal forward and backward branching fields. Their centered connected kernel $C_{\rm FB}=\mathbb E_\omega[\psi_F\psi_B]$ carries the organized reciprocal sector, where $\mathbb E_\omega$ denotes expectation over branching-noise realizations, with $\rho_{\rm BSM}=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)$ on the anticorrelated branch. Here we develop the stochastic field theory of the Bohm/Fisher feedback that acts on this connected sector. Starting from the multiplicative branching covariance of BSM, a Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) formulation and a causal two-loop two-particle-irreducible (2PI) closure are used to determine response and correlation functions self-consistently. The free connected theory exhibits secular growth and ultraviolet accumulation, whereas the dressed theory develops a finite relative screening length. A reduced numerical evolution shows bounded formation of this localized sector, and a self-similar Fisher construction defines the saturated information velocity $c_\star$. A Born-Oppenheimer separation then distinguishes internal relative organization from collective propagation. Restoring the complete frequency structure gives two fixed-$q$ pole families: a gapless difference branch and a gapped sum branch. The infrared velocity of the difference branch approaches $c_\star$ at saturation. The common cone and the projected sum-sector gap are then formulated as additional fixed-point matching conditions for the collective theory.
summary:
论文 I 通过将薛定谔-长泽对提升到互易的前向和后向分支场，引入了分支随机力学 (BSM)。它们的中心连接核 $C_{\rm FB}=\mathbb E_\omega[\psi_F\psi_B]$ 带有组织的倒数扇区，其中 $\mathbb E_\omega$ 表示对分支噪声实现的期望，$\rho_{\rm BSM}=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)$ 位于反相关分支上。在这里，我们开发了作用于该连通区域的玻姆/费舍尔反馈的随机场论。从 BSM 的乘法分支协方差出发，使用 Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) 公式和因果二环二粒子不可约 (2PI) 闭包来自洽地确定响应和相关函数。自由连接理论表现出长期生长和紫外线积累，而穿着理论则发展出有限的相对屏蔽长度。简化的数值演化显示了该局部扇区的有界形成，并且自相似费希尔构造定义了饱和信息速度 $c_\star$。

玻恩-奥本海默分离将内部相关组织与集体传播区分开来。恢复完整的频率结构给出两个固定$q$极族：无间隙差分支和有间隙和分支。差分分支的红外速度在饱和时接近$c_\star$。然后将共同锥体和预计扇区总和间隙公式化为集体理论的附加定点匹配条件。

title: A Wannier-first approach for extended chiral systems
abstract: We present a real-space formulation of DFT for extended systems in which localized Wannier-like functions are constructed directly from localized Gaussian basis functions without explicitly computing canonical Bloch-like states during the self-consistent cycle. Building on the formalism of Pederson and Lin [Phys. Rev. B \textbf{35}, 2273 (1987)], a variational set of Wannier-like functions is generated self-consistently within a finite Wannier domain and used to construct the charge density, electrostatic potential, and per cell total energy of the extended system. The occupied space can be determined entirely from the Wannier-like functions. Electronic band structures can be recovered in a post-processing step by solving the full Hamiltonian in a Bloch-like basis constructed from Gaussian orbitals. A key feature of the method is that it can incorporate combined translation--rotation, or screw, symmetries, enabling efficient simulations of chiral and helical systems with finite twist angles at essentially the same computational cost as systems described by pure translational symmetry. The approach is validated through calculations on linear and twisted $\mathrm{{-}C{\equiv}C{-}}$ and $\mathrm{{-}Li{-}F{-}}$ chains, as well as graphene, where total energies and band structures show excellent agreement with reference periodic calculations. To illustrate the ability of the method to treat three-dimensional systems, it is further applied to AA graphite, in which carbon atoms in adjacent graphene layers are aligned directly above one another, as well as helically stacked AA graphite structures. The Wannier-first framework provides a practical route for treating extended systems with nontrivial translational, rotational, and screw symmetries, and provides a natural foundation for the implementation of orbital-dependent functionals such as the Perdew--Zunger self-interaction correction.
summary:
我们提出了扩展系统的 DFT 实空间公式，其中局部类 Wannier 函数直接从局部高斯基函数构造，而无需在自洽循环期间显式计算规范类 Bloch 状态。以 Pederson 和 Lin 的形式主义为基础 [Phys. Rev. B \textbf{35}, 2273 (1987)]，在有限的 Wannier 域内自洽地生成一组变分类 Wannier 函数，并用于构造扩展系统的电荷密度、静电势和每个细胞的总能量。所占据的空间可以完全由类 Wannier 函数确定。通过在由高斯轨道构建的类布洛赫基中求解完整的哈密顿量，可以在后处理步骤中恢复电子能带结构。该方法的一个关键特征是它可以结合平移-旋转或螺旋对称组合，从而能够以与纯平移对称描述的系统基本相同的计算成本对具有有限扭转角的手性和螺旋系统进行有效模拟。

该方法通过对线性和扭曲的 $\mathrm{{-}C{\equiv}C{-}}$ 和 $\mathrm{{-}Li{-}F{-}}$ 链以及石墨烯的计算进行了验证，其中总能量和能带结构与参考周期计算显示出极好的一致性。为了说明该方法处理三维系统的能力，它进一步应用于 AA 石墨，其中相邻石墨烯层中的碳原子直接排列在彼此之上，以及螺旋堆叠的 AA 石墨结构。 Wannier-first 框架为处理具有非平凡平移、旋转和螺旋对称性的扩展系统提供了一条实用途径，并为实现轨道相关泛函（例如 Perdew-Zunger 自相互作用校正）提供了天然基础。

title: All-dry processing of 3C-SiC nanomechanical string resonators for extreme aspect ratios and high intrinsic quality factor
abstract: Conventional fabrication of suspended nanomechanical resonators typically relies on wet-chemical process steps and critical point drying, which can compromise sample yield and cleanliness. Here, we present an all-dry fabrication process for strongly stressed 3C-SiC nanomechanical string resonators that entirely avoids wet-chemical etching and cleaning. Using a negative-tone electron-beam resist as an etch mask and a three-step reactive-ion etching process for both structuring and release, we achieve high fabrication yield, clean suspended structures, and extreme aspect ratios of 8.500. We perform full mechanical characterization of the resulting doubly-clamped nanostring resonators, and establish a benchmark intrinsic quality factor for dissipation-diluted 3C-SiC of Qintr = 4.200.
summary: 悬浮纳米机械谐振器的传统制造通常依赖于湿化学工艺步骤和临界点干燥，这可能会损害样品产量和清洁度。在这里，我们提出了一种用于强应力 3C-SiC 纳米机械弦谐振器的全干法制造工艺，完全避免了湿法化学蚀刻和清洁。使用负性电子束抗蚀剂作为蚀刻掩模，并采用三步反应离子蚀刻工艺进行结构化和释放，我们实现了高制造良率、清洁的悬浮结构和 8.500 的极端纵横比。我们对由此产生的双钳位纳米弦谐振器进行了完整的机械表征，并为耗散稀释的 3C-SiC 建立了 Qintr = 4.200 的基准内在品质因数。

title: Memory-driven Topological Defects and Unconventional Long-Range Order
abstract: We investigate many-body systems with time-delayed self-interactions mediated by a memory-feedback mechanism. We show that such temporal interactions generate non-equilibrium orders and unique topological defects absent in equilibrium-specifically, helical vortices wherein opposite vorticities propagate in reverse directions along domain walls. In one dimension, memory feedback stabilizes true long-range order against weak noise, thereby circumventing the Mermin-Wagner theorem and resulting in an unconventional finite-temperature phase transition with a dynamical exponent $z = 4$. Physical realizations of these memory-driven non-equilibrium systems using active mechatronic metamaterials has also been proposed. These results demonstrate engineered temporal interactions as a powerful paradigm for non-equilibrium many-body physics.
summary: 我们研究了由记忆反馈机制介导的具有延时自交互的多体系统。我们表明，这种时间相互作用会产生非平衡顺序和平衡中不存在的独特拓扑缺陷，特别是螺旋涡旋，其中相反的涡旋沿着磁畴壁以相反的方向传播。在一维中，记忆反馈稳定了真正的长程有序以对抗弱噪声，从而规避了 Mermin-Wagner 定理并导致动态指数 $z = 4$ 的非常规有限温度相变。还提出了使用主动机电超材料来物理实现这些内存驱动的非平衡系统。这些结果表明，工程时间相互作用是非平衡多体物理学的强大范例。

title: Multivariate hyperdensity functional theory for inhomogeneous equilibrium fluids: From first principles to simulation-based machine learning
abstract: Hyperdensity functional theory facilitates the investigation of the equilibrium behavior of a general order parameter or statistical mechanical observable in spatially inhomogeneous classical many-body systems. The approach is based on applying the exact Mermin-Evans classical density functional mapping to an extended ensemble. Here we present the multivariate generalization for investigating simultaneously the properties and interrelations of several different hyperobservables of choice. The resulting framework gives rise to a systematic characterization and prediction scheme for general many-body phenomena. All pertinent equilibrium averages, variances, and covariances constitute universal density functionals, as we demonstrate explicitly. Associated one-body hyperfluctuation profiles quantify the degree of correlation of the local density with first- and second-order combinations of hyperobservables. These multivariate hyperfluctuation profiles are accessible in many-body simulations and they satisfy exact hyper-Ornstein-Zernike equations, which we derive from the minimization principle in the extended multivariate ensemble. The formal structure of the theory integrates naturally with supervised machine learning, which renders all hyperdensity functionals accessible in practice via training of neural networks on simulation data. We demonstrate all salient techniques using the illustrative case of clustering in confined hard rod fluids, thereby choosing the total number of particles and the largest cluster size as the representative hyperobservables of interest. Our numerical methodology enables the efficient and successful prediction of all statistical quantities induced by the chosen hyperobservables, which we verify via comparison to test data and which we attribute to the tight interplay of first-principles and machine-learning concepts that our general approach combines.
summary:
超密度泛函理论有助于研究空间非均匀经典多体系统中一般有序参数或统计力学可观测量的平衡行为。该方法基于将精确的 Mermin-Evans 经典密度泛函映射应用于扩展系综。在这里，我们提出了多变量概括，用于同时研究几种不同的超可观测量的属性和相互关系。由此产生的框架为一般多体现象提供了系统的表征和预测方案。正如我们明确证明的那样，所有相关的平衡平均值、方差和协方差构成了通用密度泛函。相关的单体超涨落剖面量化了局部密度与超可观测量的一阶和二阶组合的相关程度。这些多元超涨落曲线可以在多体模拟中获得，并且它们满足精确的超奥恩斯坦-泽尼克方程，该方程是我们从扩展多元系综中的最小化原理推导出来的。

该理论的形式结构与监督机器学习自然地结合在一起，通过模拟数据上的神经网络训练，使所有超密度泛函在实践中变得可访问。我们使用受限硬棒流体中的聚类说明性案例演示了所有显着技术，从而选择粒子总数和最大簇大小作为感兴趣的代表性超可观测量。我们的数值方法能够有效、成功地预测由所选超可观测量引起的所有统计量，我们通过与测试数据的比较来验证这一点，并将其归因于我们的通用方法所结合的第一原理和机器学习概念的紧密相互作用。

title: The Universal Role of Fragility on the Yielding Transition of Active Glass under Oscillatory Shear
abstract: The yielding transition marks the onset of irreversible plastic deformation in amorphous solids and plays a central role in determining the mechanical stability and failure of metallic glasses, colloidal suspensions, and biological assemblies. Despite extensive research, the microscopic factors governing the nature of yielding, particularly the transition between brittle and ductile mechanical responses, remain poorly understood. Recent studies have identified kinetic fragility as a key parameter governing yielding in passive glasses; whether this connection persists in active glasses remains open. Here, using molecular dynamics simulations of a Kob-Andersen glass former doped with Run-and-Tumble (RTP) active particles under oscillatory shear, we show that activity systematically reduces kinetic fragility and consequently alters the mechanical response. The common yield point $\gamma_c$ decreases monotonically with activity and exhibits a power-law dependence on the Arrhenius activation barrier. Increasing activity suppresses the dependence of the yield strain on thermal history and transforms the response from brittle-like to increasingly ductile, with smoother stress relaxation and reduced stress discontinuities. The timescale to reach steady state near yielding retains a critical power-law divergence, indicating that activity does not alter the underlying critical character of the transition. Active glasses also develop broader, more diffuse shear bands. Our results establish kinetic fragility as a unifying parameter governing yielding in both passive and active glasses and demonstrate that activity offers a powerful route to tune the mechanical response of amorphous materials.
summary:
屈服转变标志着非晶固体中不可逆塑性变形的开始，并在确定金属玻璃、胶体悬浮液和生物组件的机械稳定性和失效方面发挥着核心作用。尽管进行了广泛的研究，但控制屈服性质的微观因素，特别是脆性和延性机械响应之间的转变，仍然知之甚少。最近的研究已确定动态脆性是控制被动玻璃屈服的关键参数。这种连接是否在主动式眼镜中持续存在仍然悬而未决。在这里，通过在振荡剪切下对掺杂有运行翻滚 (RTP) 活性粒子的 Kob-Andersen 玻璃模型进行分子动力学模拟，我们发现活性系统地降低了动力学脆性，从而改变了机械响应。共同屈服点 $\gamma_c$ 随着活性单调降低，并表现出对阿累尼乌斯激活势垒的幂律依赖性。

活性的增加抑制了屈服应变对热历史的依赖性，并将响应从脆性响应转变为逐渐延展的响应，同时应力松弛更加平滑并减少了应力不连续性。达到接近屈服稳定状态的时间尺度保留了关键的幂律发散，表明活动不会改变转变的潜在关键特征。主动玻璃还产生更宽、更扩散的剪切带。我们的结果将动力学脆性确定为控制被动和主动玻璃屈服的统一参数，并证明活性提供了调整非晶材料机械响应的有力途径。

title: Thermodynamic optimization of thermal landscapes and energy barriers in a Brownian heat engine
abstract: Spatial temperature fields in Brownian heat engines are commonly prescribed \emph{a priori}, and the resulting transport and thermodynamic properties are then calculated. Here we formulate the complementary inverse-design problem: determining the temperature profile and barrier height that optimize a chosen thermodynamic objective. We consider an overdamped Brownian particle in a symmetric triangular periodic potential under a constant opposing load and derive the exact stationary current and probability density for an arbitrary bounded temperature field, $\Tc\le T(x)\le\Th$. In the quasistatic limit, the efficiency becomes an exact functional of two inverse-temperature integrals over the uphill and downhill branches. Its rigorous global maximum under the pointwise temperature bounds is $\eta_{\max}=1-\Tc/\Th$, attained uniquely, up to sets of measure zero, by the hot-uphill/cold-downhill piecewise-constant profile. At finite current, however, the optimization changes qualitatively because the current is determined jointly by the cycle affinity and a nonlocal transport resistance. We derive the exact functional gradient and the corresponding box-constrained optimality conditions, showing that the current- or power-maximizing profile generally differs from the quasistatic efficiency optimum. For any prescribed temperature field, the current-maximizing barrier satisfies an exact balance between the marginal gain in thermal rectification and the marginal increase in transport resistance, with the characteristic estimate $U_0^*\simeq T_{\rm act}$, where $T_{\rm act}^{-1}=(2/L)\int_0^{L/2}\dd x/T(x)$.
summary:
布朗热机中的空间温度场通常被规定为 \emph{先验}，然后计算所得的传输和热力学性质。在这里，我们制定了互补的逆向设计问题：确定优化所选热力学目标的温度分布和势垒高度。我们考虑在恒定反向载荷下对称三角周期势中的过阻尼布朗粒子，并导出任意有界温度场 $\Tc\le T(x)\le\Th$ 的精确稳态电流和概率密度。在准静态极限下，效率成为上坡和下坡分支上两个反温度积分的精确函数。其在逐点温度范围下的严格全局最大值为 $\eta_{\max}=1-\Tc/\Th$，通过热上坡/冷下坡分段常数曲线唯一获得，直至测量值为零。然而，在有限电流下，优化发生了质的变化，因为电流是由循环亲和力和非局部传输阻力共同决定的。

我们推导了精确的函数梯度和相应的框约束最优性条件，表明电流或功率最大化曲线通常不同于准静态效率最优值。对于任何规定的温度场，电流最大化势垒满足热整流的边际增益和传输电阻的边际增加之间的精确平衡，特征估计为$U_0^*\simeq T_{\rm act}$，其中$T_{\rm act}^{-1}=(2/L)\int_0^{L/2}\dd x/T(x)$。

title: Pure FENE Bond Potential for Soft Matter and Biological Simulations: Theory, HOOMD-blue Implementation, and Applications to Polymer, Colloidal, and Membrane Systems
abstract: The finitely extensible nonlinear elastic (FENE) potential is widely used as a bonded interaction in coarse-grained simulations of polymers, soft matter, colloids, and biological systems. In the classical Kremer--Grest framework, FENE bonding is combined with a short-range Weeks--Chandler--Andersen (WCA) interaction to provide finite bond extensibility together with excluded-volume repulsion. Although this combination is highly successful, it intrinsically couples bonded elasticity to the nonbonded interaction, limiting the ability to independently control these two contributions. Here, we introduce a standalone FENE bond potential in HOOMD-blue in which finite bond extensibility is implemented independently of the choice of nonbonded interaction. This formulation allows the same FENE bond potential to be combined with WCA, Lennard--Jones, or other pair interactions without modifying the bonded interaction itself. We demonstrate the utility of the standalone formulation in coarse-grained polymer chains, colloidal networks, and mesh-based biological membrane models. Across these systems, Pure FENE bonding without short-range excluded-volume stabilization produces pronounced structural contraction, whereas the addition of WCA repulsion suppresses this collapse and preserves finite, spatially extended structures. These results demonstrate that separating finite bond extensibility from steric interactions provides independent control over local bond mechanics and collective structural organization. The standalone FENE formulation therefore provides a modular framework for coarse-grained simulations in which molecular connectivity and nonbonded interactions represent distinct physical mechanisms.
summary:
有限可扩展非线性弹性 (FENE) 势作为键合相互作用广泛应用于聚合物、软物质、胶体和生物系统的粗粒度模拟中。在经典的 Kremer-Grest 框架中，FENE 键合与短程 Weeks-Chandler-Andersen (WCA) 相互作用相结合，提供有限的键可扩展性和排除体积排斥力。尽管这种组合非常成功，但它本质上将键合弹性与非键合相互作用耦合在一起，限制了独立控制这两种贡献的能力。在这里，我们引入了 HOOMD-blue 中的独立 FENE 键势，其中有限键可扩展性的实现与非键相互作用的选择无关。该公式允许相同的 FENE 键势与 WCA、Lennard-Jones 或其他对相互作用相结合，而无需修改键合相互作用本身。我们展示了独立配方在粗粒聚合物链、胶体网络和基于网格的生物膜模型中的实用性。

在这些系统中，没有短程排除体积稳定的纯 FENE 键合会产生明显的结构收缩，而添加 WCA 排斥力会抑制这种塌陷并保留有限的空间延伸结构。这些结果表明，将有限键可扩展性与空间相互作用分开可以提供对局部键力学和集体结构组织的独立控制。因此，独立的 FENE 公式为粗粒度模拟提供了一个模块化框架，其中分子连接性和非键相互作用代表了不同的物理机制。

title: Survival in a partially reactive wedge
abstract: We investigate the power-law decay of the survival probability of a Brownian particle diffusing in an infinite planar wedge whose two sides are partially reactive and described by Robin boundary conditions. We employ matched asymptotic analysis to relate the long-time asymptotics to a stationary harmonic Robin problem near the apex. This approach determines the persistence exponent for arbitrary opening angles and yields the prefactor explicitly for the family of wedges with $\alpha=\pi/n$ ($n=1,2,\ldots$). A simple extension of the apex prefactor to arbitrary angles is conjectured and supported numerically. This asymptotic behavior describes the crossover to the well-known result for perfectly absorbing wedges. As immediate applications, we also deduce the long-time behavior of the probability density function of the boundary local time on wedge sides, as well as the probability density function of the associated first-crossing time.
summary: 我们研究了在无限平面楔中扩散的布朗粒子的生存概率的幂律衰减，该楔的两侧是部分反应的并由罗宾边界条件描述。我们采用匹配渐近分析将长时间渐近与顶点附近的平稳谐波罗宾问题联系起来。这种方法确定了任意张角的持续指数，并为具有 $\alpha=\pi/n$ ($n=1,2,\ldots$) 的楔形族明确生成前因子。推测并支持了顶点预因子到任意角度的简单扩展。这种渐近行为描述了与完美吸收楔形的众所周知结果的交叉。作为直接应用，我们还推导了楔侧边界本地时间的概率密度函数的长期行为，以及相关的首次穿越时间的概率密度函数。

title: Liquid-liquid phase transitions in dipolar liquids. Insights into Supercooled Water
abstract: Dipolar liquids combine two coupled degrees of freedom, translational and dipolar. Intriguingly, these two sectors can reside in distinct thermodynamic states, with the state of one sector possibly favoring a specific state of the other. The onset of ferroelectric order in dipolar liquids is an example of this mutual stabilization. Since this coupling is often encoded in interaction potentials, projecting out one sector to derive an effective interaction for the other can uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying this phenomenon. A coarse-grained theory in which the distance between nearest-neighbor particles depends on their dipolar interaction through a density-dependent mechanical compliance shows that a ferroelectric transition can trigger a liquid-liquid transition. It also predicts a first-order liquid-liquid transition in the paraelectric phase that can in turn induce ferroelectric ordering. The anisotropic dipolar-dependent soft-core interaction is shown to lead to an effective Jagla-like isotropic two-length-scale interaction, known to support liquid-liquid phase transitions. Here, however, the two-length-scale pattern depends on density and dipolar configuration, becoming sensitive to dipolar order. Analysis of supercooled TIP4P/Ice water numerical simulations shows that first-coordination-shell features of pair correlation functions are sensitive to dipolar interaction, supporting the coarse-grained theory foundations. Comparison of low- and high-density liquid water reveals enhanced spatial anisotropy of the first coordination shell in the low-density liquid, with increased effective excluded volume, showing that the liquid-liquid transition involves structural changes within the first shell, beyond reorganization of the interstitial region and tetrahedral order. These findings point to a role for dipolar interactions in supercooled water liquid-liquid phase transition.
summary:
偶极液体结合了两个耦合的自由度：平动自由度和偶极自由度。有趣的是，这两个部分可以处于不同的热力学状态，其中一个部分的状态可能有利于另一个部分的特定状态。偶极液体中铁电有序的开始就是这种相互稳定的一个例子。由于这种耦合通常被编码在相互作用势中，因此投影一个部分以导出另一个部分的有效相互作用可以揭示这一现象背后的微观机制。在粗粒度理论中，最近邻粒子之间的距离取决于它们通过密度相关的机械柔量的偶极相互作用，表明铁电转变可以触发液-液转变。它还预测了顺电相中的一级液-液转变，这反过来又可以引起铁电有序化。各向异性偶极相关软核相互作用被证明可以产生有效的类 Jagla 各向同性双长度尺度相互作用，已知该相互作用支持液-液相变。

然而，在这里，双长度尺度图案取决于密度和偶极配置，对偶极顺序变得敏感。过冷TIP4P/冰水数值模拟分析表明，配对相关函数的第一配位壳层特征对偶极相互作用敏感，支持了粗粒度理论基础。低密度和高密度液态水的比较揭示了低密度液体中第一配位壳的空间各向异性增强，有效排除体积增加，表明液-液转变涉及第一壳内的结构变化，超出了间隙区域和四面体顺序的重组。这些发现指出了偶极相互作用在过冷水液-液相变中的作用。

title: Response of a Model Glass to Athermal Quasistatic Pinching
abstract: We numerically investigate the mechanical response of amorphous solids to localized force dipoles, referred to as pinching, using athermal quasistatic simulations of model glasses with varying degrees of stability. We employ a control parameter, the imposed extension, corresponding to the increase in rest length between the two pinched particles relative to their initial separation. Increasing this extension allows us to continuously tune the system from the elastic to the plastic regime. For small extensions, the response remains elastic. In this regime, the displacement field induced by pinching is well described by linear elasticity and exhibits a long-range power-law decay consistent with dipolar forcing. Averaged responses display anisotropic, quadrupolar-like patterns, with quantitative agreement between simulations and analytical predictions. This continuum description remains valid down to particle-scale distances. As the imposed extension increases, the response becomes plastic. Pinching can then trigger either localized or system-spanning rearrangements, depending on glass stability. Well-annealed glasses exhibit localized plastic events, whereas poorly annealed systems display delocalized cascades. We introduce a method to extract the principal axis of plastic deformation and analyze the associated displacement fields and plastic activity. Overall, our results demonstrate that pinching provides a minimal local probe of amorphous solids. The resulting response, governed by both glass stability and imposed extension, offers insight into the interplay between elasticity, elementary rearrangements, and the emergence of collective plasticity.
summary:
我们使用具有不同稳定性程度的模型玻璃的非热准静态模拟，以数值方式研究非晶固体对局部力偶极子的机械响应（称为箍缩）。我们采用一个控制参数，即施加的延伸，对应于两个被挤压的颗粒之间相对于其初始分离的静止长度的增加。增加这个扩展使我们能够不断地将系统从弹性状态调整到塑性状态。对于小扩展，响应保持弹性。在这种情况下，由收缩引起的位移场可以通过线性弹性很好地描述，并且表现出与偶极力一致的长程幂律衰减。平均响应显示各向异性、类四极模式，模拟和分析预测之间具有定量一致性。这种连续统描述在粒子尺度距离下仍然有效。随着施加的延伸增加，响应变得可塑。然后，根据玻璃的稳定性，捏合可以触发局部或系统范围的重新排列。

退火良好的玻璃表现出局部塑性事件，而退火不良的系统则表现出离域级联。我们介绍了一种提取塑性变形主轴并分析相关位移场和塑性活动的方法。总的来说，我们的结果表明，箍缩提供了对无定形固体的最小局部探测。由此产生的响应，由玻璃稳定性和强加延伸控制，提供了对弹性、基本重排和集体可塑性的出现之间相互作用的洞察。

title: From Goldene to Noblene: exhaustive enumeration of the ordered Au-Ag-Cu monolayer alloys
abstract: Two-dimensional metals became a laboratory reality with the isolation of Goldene, a gold sheet one atom thick released by chemical exfoliation, which raises the question of what alloying can achieve on the same close-packed lattice. Here we combine an exhaustive enumeration of derivative superstructures with density functional theory to map the ordered Au-Ag-Cu monolayer alloys, relaxing every symmetry-inequivalent arrangement up to four atoms per cell and extending the set with larger cells selected by a fitted model. We find that the arrangement of the atoms, and not their proportion, controls the mixing energy, since the spread among the orderings of a single composition is several times the step between neighboring compositions, one composition spans more than 50~meV/atom between two arrangements of the same three atoms, and at two compositions the arrangement decides the sign. The energetics is carried by a competition between Au-Cu contacts, which bind, and Ag-Cu contacts, which do not, and bulk enthalpies computed under the same protocol show that this chemistry is not uniformly rescaled in two dimensions, since Au-Cu orders more strongly in the monolayer than in the crystal while the other two weaken. A pair model completed by an elastic size-mismatch term reproduces the computed energies to a few meV/atom and returns a composition landscape whose convex hull no balanced ternary composition reaches. One equimolar ordering, which we name Noblene, is the only structure in which every atom is surrounded exclusively by unlike species, and it is dynamically stable and metallic, and carries a Poisson's ratio above one half, higher than that of any of the three pure monolayers. Since Noblene sits on the lattice that Goldene already realizes, the route that produced Goldene is a plausible starting point for its synthesis.
summary:
随着 Goldene 的分离，二维金属成为了实验室现实，Goldene 是一种通过化学剥离释放出的一个原子厚的金片，这提出了一个问题：在相同的密排晶格上可以实现什么合金化。在这里，我们将派生超结构的详尽枚举与密度泛函理论结合起来，绘制有序的 Au-Ag-Cu 单层合金，将每个对称不等价排列放宽到每个单元四个原子，并用拟合模型选择的更大单元扩展该集合。我们发现，控制混合能的是原子的排列，而不是它们的比例，因为单个组合物的排序之间的分布是相邻组合物之间步长的几倍，一个组合物在相同的三个原子的两种排列之间跨度超过 50~meV/原子，并且在两种组合物中，排列决定了符号。

能量学是通过结合的金-铜接触和不结合的银-铜接触之间的竞争来实现的，并且在同一协议下计算的体积焓表明，这种化学反应在二维上没有均匀地重新调整，因为金-铜在单层中的有序性比在晶体中更强，而其他两个则减弱。由弹性尺寸失配项完成的对模型将计算的能量再现为几个meV/原子，并返回其凸包没有平衡三元成分达到的成分景观。一种等摩尔有序，我们称之为Noblene，是唯一一种每个原子都被不同物质包围的结构，它是动态稳定的金属性的，泊松比超过一半，高于三个纯单层中任何一个的泊松比。由于 Noblene 位于 Goldene 已经实现的晶格上，因此产生 Goldene 的路线是其合成的合理起点。

title: Relating solute interactions to interfacial properties
abstract: Liquid interfaces are both ubiquitous and also critically important for many commercial products, modern technologies, biological processes, and environmental phenomena. The properties of these interfaces can depend quite sensitively upon the composition of the bulk liquid phase. In this work, we develop a dilute solution theory (DST) for the influence of dilute cosolutes upon the interface between coexisting liquid and vapor phases. We employ a grand canonical perturbation theory to rigorously relate the interfacial free energy to the concentration of the liquid solution. We leverage a corresponding Gibbs ensemble to treat liquid-vapor coexistence and to eliminate the contribution of the bulk phases from this free energy. We express the coefficients of the resulting expansion in terms of microscopic partition functions. By treating solute-solute interactions to lowest order, we distinguish between the intrinsic and effective interfacial preferences of solutes. While the former reflects only solute-solvent interactions, the latter depends upon the solution composition and reflects the influence of solute-solute interactions. We assess this DST with molecular dynamics simulations of binary and ternary mixtures of Lennard-Jones spheres. These simulations demonstrate that DST accurately models the interfacial properties of these systems up to relatively high concentrations. Moreover, the simulations illustrate the impact of attractive solute-solute interactions in converting weak intrinsic surfactants into weak effective depletants.
summary:
液体界面无处不在，对于许多商业产品、现代技术、生物过程和环境现象也至关重要。这些界面的性质可以非常敏感地取决于本体液相的组成。在这项工作中，我们开发了稀溶液理论（DST）来研究稀共溶质对共存液相和气相之间界面的影响。我们采用大正则微扰理论将界面自由能与液体溶液的浓度严格联系起来。我们利用相应的吉布斯系综来处理液气共存，并消除这种自由能中体相的贡献。我们用微观配分函数来表达所得展开的系数。通过将溶质-溶质相互作用处理为最低阶，我们区分了溶质的固有界面偏好和有效界面偏好。前者仅反映溶质-溶剂相互作用，而后者取决于溶液组成并反映溶质-溶质相互作用的影响。

我们通过 Lennard-Jones 球体二元和三元混合物的分子动力学模拟来评估此 DST。这些模拟表明，DST 可以准确地模拟这些系统在相对较高浓度下的界面特性。此外，模拟还说明了有吸引力的溶质-溶质相互作用在将弱固有表面活性剂转化为弱有效消耗剂方面的影响。

title: Systematic display of the spin splitting in band structures of representative altermagnetic crystals
abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel approach to exhibit the unique spin splitting that is typical of collinear altermagnets. This approach is to plot band structures on Brillouin zone paths that sample general k-points to show a representative picture that corresponds to Brillouin zone averages. This is in contrast to conventional band structure plotting which plots band structures on the highest-symmetry points and lines, and thus in many cases can fail to show any altermagnetic spin splitting at all. Our investigation compares the new approach with the band structures of collinear altermagnets using conventional band structure plotting. We report the band structure and symmetry analysis for MnTe, CrSb, SmFeO3, ScCrO3, LaMnO3, TlCrO3, HoFeO3, InCrO3 and DyFeO3. This result clearly demonstrates the advantage of this novel method for displaying the spin splitting of collinear altermagnets.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们展示了一种新颖的方法来展示共线交替磁体典型的独特自旋分裂。此方法是在布里渊区路径上绘制能带结构，对一般 k 点进行采样，以显示与布里渊区平均值相对应的代表性图片。这与传统的能带结构绘图相反，传统的能带结构绘图在最高对称点和线上绘制能带结构，因此在许多情况下根本无法显示任何交变磁自旋分裂。我们的研究使用传统的能带结构图将新方法与共线交变磁体的能带结构进行了比较。我们报告了 MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3 和 DyFeO3 的能带结构和对称性分析。这一结果清楚地证明了这种显示共线交变磁体自旋分裂的新颖方法的优势。

title: Emergence of the magnetic octupole Rashba-Edelstein effect from spin-orbit entanglement
abstract: Magnetic multipoles have attracted growing interest as order parameters and dynamical degrees of freedom in unconventional magnets, yet it remains unclear how broadly they can emerge as active electronic degrees of freedom. Here, we show that spin-orbit-entangled multiorbital states can host magnetic octupole (MO) degrees of freedom. In Rashba systems, this gives rise to an MO Rashba texture accompanying the J-Rashba texture. Remarkably, spin-orbital entanglement can realize a pure-MO limit in which the spin and orbital-angular-momentum textures vanish while the MO texture remains finite. An applied electric field converts this texture into a nonequilibrium MO polarization through an MO Rashba-Edelstein effect. Around the pure-MO regime, the MO Edelstein response dominates over the conventional spin response, showing that multipolar responses need not be small corrections to dipolar spin physics. Our results establish an interface-based route for electrically generating nonequilibrium multipolar magnetic polarization in spin-orbit-coupled systems.
summary: 磁性多极作为非常规磁体中的有序参数和动态自由度引起了越来越多的兴趣，但目前尚不清楚它们作为主动电子自由度的范围有多大。在这里，我们证明自旋轨道纠缠的多轨道态可以拥有磁八极（MO）自由度。在 Rashba 系统中，这会产生伴随 J-Rashba 纹理的 MO Rashba 纹理。值得注意的是，自旋轨道纠缠可以实现纯 MO 极限，其中自旋和轨道角动量纹理消失，而 MO 纹理保持有限。施加的电场通过 MO Rashba-Edelstein 效应将该纹理转换为非平衡 MO 偏振。在纯 MO 体系周围，MO Edelstein 响应优于传统的自旋响应，这表明多极响应不需要对偶极自旋物理进行小修正。我们的结果建立了一种基于界面的途径，用于在自旋轨道耦合系统中产生非平衡多极磁极化。

title: AlterSeeK-Path: Systematic construction of generalized band-structure paths for displaying altermagnetic spin splitting
abstract: Altermagnetic materials exhibit spin splitting in their electronic band structures while maintaining zero net magnetization. However, conventional high-symmetry k-paths generally hide this splitting because they follow symmetry lines that in most cases enforce spin degeneracy. We present AlterSeeK-Path, an open-source Python tool that systematically constructs generalized band-structure paths for collinear altermagnets. The method selects the centroid of the conventional irreducible wedge used in routine band-structure calculations as the representative general k-point, maps it to a spin-flip-related partner, and inserts paired segments through these points into the standard high-symmetry path; these segments systematically sample the interior of the irreducible wedge. We demonstrate the construction for all 54 three-dimensional combinations of extended Bravais lattice type and spin Laue group across the six crystal systems that support collinear altermagnetism, and for the 12 two-dimensional cases spanning the four compatible two-dimensional Bravais lattices. Representative band structures are shown for the distinct lattice/path cases. With AlterSeeK-Path, these band structures can be constructed with essentially the same effort as conventional band structures.
summary:
交变磁性材料在其电子能带结构中表现出自旋分裂，同时保持零净磁化强度。然而，传统的高对称性 k 路径通常隐藏这种分裂，因为它们遵循对称线，在大多数情况下会强制自旋简并。我们推出了 AlterSeeK-Path，这是一个开源 Python 工具，可以系统地构建共线交流磁体的广义能带结构路径。该方法选择常规能带结构计算中使用的传统不可约楔形的质心作为代表性的一般k点，将其映射到与自旋翻转相关的伙伴，并将通过这些点的成对线段插入到标准高对称路径中；这些片段系统地对不可约楔形的内部进行采样。我们演示了支持共线交变磁性的六个晶体系统中扩展布拉维晶格类型和自旋劳厄群的所有 54 种三维组合的构造，以及跨越四个兼容二维布拉维晶格的 12 个二维情况的构造。显示了不同晶格/路径情况的代表性能带结构。

利用 AlterSeeK-Path，可以用与传统能带结构基本相同的工作来构造这些能带结构。

title: First Principle Analysis of the Magnetism and Electronic Structure of Fe2XSi (X=Ti, V)
abstract: The electronic, magnetic, and mechanical properties of Fe2XSi, where X is titanium (Ti) and vanadium (V), are investigated using computational methods. Volume optimization reveals that the ground state of Fe2TiSi is a nonmagnetic narrow-band gap semiconductor, and that of Fe2VSi is a ferrimagnetic metal. The negative formation energies of both materials confirm the stability of their crystal structures. Mechanical properties confirm the static stability of the crystal structure and suggest that the titanium compound is ductile; however, the vanadium material is brittle. Density of states and band structure studies confirm the nonmagnetic semiconducting nature with an indirect band gap at {\Gamma} and X for the titanium material and the ferrimagnetic-metallic nature of the vanadium material. Electronic and magnetic properties of the materials were investigated with applied tension (negative pressure) and compression (positive pressure) to the crystal structure. The pressure study on Fe2TiSi shows a tunable band gap and a possible semiconductor-metal transition, and Fe2VSi shows a tunable magnetic moment and a possible low-spin/high-spin magnetic transition.
summary: 使用计算方法研究了 Fe2XSi（其中 X 是钛 (Ti) 和钒 (V)）的电子、磁性和机械性能。体积优化表明Fe2TiSi的基态是非磁性窄带隙半导体，Fe2VSi的基态是亚铁磁性金属。两种材料的负形成能证实了它们晶体结构的稳定性。机械性能证实了晶体结构的静态稳定性，并表明钛化合物具有延展性；然而，钒材料很脆。态密度和能带结构研究证实了钛材料在 {\Gamma} 和 X 处具有间接带隙的非磁性半导体性质以及钒材料的亚铁磁性金属性质。通过对晶体结构施加张力（负压）和压缩（正压）来研究材料的电子和磁性。对 Fe2TiSi 的压力研究显示了可调节的带隙和可能的半导体-金属转变，而 Fe2VSi 显示了可调节的磁矩和可能的低自旋/高自旋磁转变。

title: Repairing PBE-Spurious Metallicity for HSE06-Level Screening of 2D Photocatalysts for Green Hydrogen Production
abstract: Semilocal PBE calculations can remove viable photocatalysts before screening by labeling narrow-gap semiconductors as metals. We address this failure mode in the Computational 2D Materials Database (C2DB) by combining leakage-aware repair of PBE-spurious metallicity with HSE06--PBE $\Delta$-learning. Stage~I classifies HSE06-unknown PBE metals using structural, chemical, magnetic, and stability descriptors, while excluding HSE06/GW quantities and PBE electronic shortcuts. Stage~II learns $E_g^{HSE} - E_g^{PBE}$ for the corrected insulating population. The curated XGBoost regressor reconstructs HSE06 gaps with a mean absolute error of 0.108~eV ($R^2=0.989$), compared with 1.036~eV for raw PBE. The Stage~I classifier is used only for triage because the labeled true-metal class contains 29 materials; its best holdout performance gives 87.5\% accuracy, 0.286 true-metal recall, and 0.643 balanced accuracy. The corrected pH~0 electronic screen yields 10 strict and 29 initial relaxed green-hydrogen photocatalyst candidates. Four strict and 18 relaxed candidates would fail the same 1.6--2.8~eV gap window at the PBE level. Targeted VASP HSE06 calculations for six ML-predicted compounds give material-level MAEs of 0.417, 0.182, and 0.110~eV for the C2DB-native, Magpie+structural, and curated models, respectively; \feat{1AgBr-1} shifts above the upper gap cutoff, leaving 28 retained relaxed candidates. The workflow shows that high-fidelity correction must be evaluated by candidate membership, not only by global regression error.
summary:
半局部 PBE 计算可以在筛选之前通过将窄带隙半导体标记为金属来去除可行的光催化剂。我们通过将 PBE 杂散金属度的泄漏感知修复与 HSE06--PBE $\Delta$-学习相结合来解决计算 2D 材料数据库 (C2DB) 中的这种故障模式。 Stage~I 使用结构、化学、磁性和稳定性描述符对 HSE06 未知的 PBE 金属进行分类，同时排除 HSE06/GW 数量和 PBE 电子快捷方式。 Stage~II 学习 $E_g^{HSE} - E_g^{PBE}$ 来校正绝缘群体。精心设计的 XGBoost 回归器重建 HSE06 间隙，平均绝对误差为 0.108~eV ($R^2=0.989$)，而原始 PBE 的平均绝对误差为 1.036~eV。 Stage~I 分类器仅用于分类，因为标记的真金属类别包含 29 种材料；其最佳的保留性能可提供 87.5% 的准确度、0.286 的真实金属召回率和 0.643 的平衡准确度。校正后的 pH~0 电子屏幕产生 10 种严格的和 29 种初始宽松的绿氢光催化剂候选物。 4 个严格候选者和 18 个宽松候选者将无法通过 PBE 级别的相同 1.6--2.8~eV 间隙窗口。

针对六种 ML 预测化合物的目标 VASP HSE06 计算得出，C2DB 原生模型、Magpie+结构模型和策划模型的材料级 MAE 分别为 0.417、0.182 和 0.110~eV； \feat{1AgBr-1} 移至间隙上限之上，留下 28 个保留的宽松候选者。该工作流程表明，高保真校正必须通过候选成员资格来评估，而不仅仅是通过全局回归误差来评估。

title: Holographic algebras at null infinity
abstract: We construct an algebra of observables associated to a cut of null infinity in asymptotically flat spacetimes. The Bondi mass associated with a sharp cut of future null infinity is not a well-defined quantum operator: its fluctuations diverge even after smearing in retarded time. We instead introduce a finite-radius, time-smeared version of the Bondi mass and adjoin this operator to the matter and graviton observables in an arbitrarily small asymptotic neighborhood of the cut. We separately analyze spacetimes with and without black holes and find, in both cases, Type III$_1$ von Neumann algebras that satisfy non-trivial nesting relations. In Minkowski spacetime, the resulting algebra reconstructs the spacelike wedge associated with the cut. In a stationary black hole spacetime, it reconstructs the region bounded by the cut and the black hole bifurcation surface, providing an asymptotically flat analogue of an entanglement wedge. In the limit as the cut is moved to past infinity, we recover a Type I$_{\infty}$ algebra for spacetimes without black holes and a Type II$_{\infty}$ algebra for black hole spacetimes. For algebras at finite cuts of retarded time, we construct a Type II$_\infty$ regularization of the black hole algebra whose renormalized von Neumann entropy agrees with the generalized entropy. In appendices, we prove two technical results about quantum fields, in a Schwarzschild spacetime, that asymptote to the Minkowski vacuum at infinity: a split property for unbounded, spacelike separated regions and the construction of a faithful, normal, and semifinite Hartle-Hawking weight whose modular flow is Schwarzschild time evolution.
summary:
我们构建了一个与渐近平坦时空中的零无穷大割相关的可观测量代数。与未来零无穷大的锐减相关的邦迪质量并不是一个明确定义的量子算符：即使在延迟时间中涂抹后，它的涨落也会发散。相反，我们引入了邦迪质量的有限半径、时间涂抹版本，并将该算子与任意小的渐近邻域中的物质和引力子可观测量邻接。我们分别分析有黑洞和没有黑洞的时空，并在这两种情况下找到满足非平凡嵌套关系的 III$_1$ 冯诺依曼代数。在闵可夫斯基时空中，所得代数重建了与切割相关的类空楔。在静止的黑洞时空中，它重建了由切口和黑洞分叉面界定的区域，提供了纠缠楔形的渐近平坦模拟。在切割移动到无穷大的极限中，我们恢复了无黑洞时空的 I$_{\infty}$ 代数和黑洞时空的 II$_{\infty}$ 代数。

对于延迟时间有限割的代数，我们构造了黑洞代数的 II$_\infty$ 正则化，其重正化冯·诺依曼熵与广义熵一致。在附录中，我们证明了关于在史瓦西时空中渐近于无穷远明可夫斯基真空的量子场的两个技术结果：无界、类似空间的分离区域的分裂性质以及忠实、正常、半有限的哈特尔-霍金权重的构造，其模流是史瓦西时间演化。

title: On-shell recursion and soft theorems for worldline quantum field theory
