我们启动了量子密码学的有时间限制的元复杂性计划。最近的工作通过在量子可采样分布上近似简单的、不可计算的柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂性的平均情况硬度来描述单向谜题，即没有单向函数的量子密码学的最小搜索原语；相比之下，Liu 和 Pass 的经典程序则存在于多项式时间界限内。我们为经典弦定义了概率有时间限制的量子程序复杂度 pKq^t 并证明了两个无条件定理。首先，量子编码定理：具有概率 delta 的量子多项式时间采样器输出的任何字符串都承认信息理论上最佳长度 log(1/delta) 加上对数项的描述，可通过连贯执行的采样器上的幅度放大，由量子机在 O(sqrt(1/delta)) 乘以多项式的时间内解码。其次，次指数时间的精确表征：当且仅当 pKq 在时间界限 2^(n/2) poly(n) 的间隙问题是弱量子平均困难时，才存在单向难题，从而改进了简单复杂性表征。

然后，我们将多项式时间编码定理分离为程序的单一承载开放猜想，证明它暗示了完整的多项式时间表征，分析了为什么经典的去随机化证明抵制量化，并制定了一种相对化障碍猜想，在单向谜题中界定了字符串值元复杂性。猜想自始至终都被贴上这样的标签。

title: Quantum amplitude estimation beyond power-of-two schedules
abstract: Non-adaptive quantum amplitude estimation (QAE) fixes its Grover depths in advance, so every circuit can run in parallel, but it has so far needed more queries than the best adaptive methods. We show that most of this gap comes from two conventional choices: subspace-based post-processing and power-of-two depth ladders. We replace the first by the exact maximum-likelihood estimate, one matrix multiplication per batch of estimates, and the second by a geometric ladder with ratio $r \approx 1.45$. The result is a fully parallel, deterministic-schedule estimator with total query complexity $2.8$-$3.1/\varepsilon$ at 95% confidence for target errors from $3.5\times 10^{-3}$ to $10^{-6}$. This matches the average-case complexity of chebAE, the best benchmarked adaptive method, within statistical uncertainty (with the lower point estimate at every scale tested), beats its maximum-observed complexity by $1.6\times$, and needs a maximum sequential depth of only $0.21/\varepsilon$ against chebAE's $2.9/\varepsilon$. Relative to csAE, the best non-adaptive benchmark, the constants improve by 30-35% at 95% and $1.5$-$1.7\times$ at 99% confidence. The optimal ratio has a simple origin. Doubling is the fastest depth growth at which the data can still tell neighboring candidate values apart, so power-of-two ladders sit at the edge of confusion and must buy reliability with extra shots; a slightly denser ladder checks every scale redundantly. An error-probability analysis reproduces the measured failure rates and locates the optimum. The likelihood formulation extends directly to noise-aware estimation, and uniformly scaling the capped ladder covers the depth-limited regime, realizing the optimal trade-off $M N_{\mathrm{tot}} \approx (0.4$-$0.6)/\varepsilon^2$ within $\sim 1.1\times$ of the schedule's Cramér-Rao limit.
summary:
非自适应量子幅度估计（QAE）提前固定其 Grover 深度，因此每个电路都可以并行运行，但迄今为止它需要比最佳自适应方法更多的查询。我们表明，这种差距大部分来自两种传统选择：基于子空间的后处理和二次方深度阶梯。我们将第一个替换为精确的最大似然估计，每批估计进行一次矩阵乘法，将第二个替换为比率为 $r \approx 1.45$ 的几何阶梯。结果是一个完全并行的确定性调度估计器，总查询复杂度为 $2.8$-$3.1/\varepsilon$，目标误差从 $3.5\times 10^{-3}$ 到 $10^{-6}$ 的置信度为 95%。这与 chebAE（最佳基准自适应方法）的平均情况复杂度相匹配，在统计不确定性范围内（在每个测试的尺度上都有较低的点估计），比其最大观察到的复杂度高出 $1.6\times$，并且需要的最大顺序深度仅为 $0.21/\varepsilon$，而 chebAE 的 $2.9/\varepsilon$。相对于最好的非自适应基准 csAE，常数在 95% 置信度下提高了 30-35%，在 99% 置信度下提高了 1.5$-$1.7\times$。最佳比例的起源很简单。

加倍是最快的深度增长，此时数据仍然可以区分相邻的候选值，因此二次方阶梯处于混乱的边缘，必须通过额外的尝试来购买可靠性；稍微密集的梯子会冗余地检查每个尺度。错误概率分析可重现测量到的故障率并找到最佳值。似然公式直接扩展到噪声感知估计，并统一缩放上限阶梯覆盖深度限制区域，实现最优权衡 $M N_{\mathrm{tot}} \approx (0.4$-$0.6)/\varepsilon^2$ 在调度 Cramér-Rao 限制的 $\sim 1.1\times$ 内。

title: Effective quasiparticle conserving Lindbladians in the thermodynamic limit
abstract: Open quantum many-body systems are commonly described by Lindblad master equations, yet the treatment of Lindbladian operators in the thermodynamic limit remains a major challenge. We develop a framework for constructing effective quasiparticle-conserving Lindbladian operators directly in the thermodynamic limit. Our approach extends continuous similarity transformations to non-Hermitian open quantum systems and enables the systematic block diagonalization of Lindbladians with respect to the quasiparticle (qp) number. We formulate two complementary methods. The first, projective continuous similarity transformations (pcst++), generalizes perturbative continuous unitary transformations to Lindblad operators so that a linked-cluster expansion allows us to obtain high-order series expansions of the infinite system. The second, deepCST, extends directly evaluated enhanced perturbative continuous unitary transformations by combining the same qp-conserving generator with a perturbative truncation scheme that yields non-perturbative effective Lindbladian operators directly in thermodynamic limit. We apply pcst++ and deepCST to the dissipative transverse-field Ising chain with local dissipation. We focus on the low-Ising regime. We purify the Lindbladian by splitting each spin into two sites. A spin flip then corresponds to two qps. We derive and analyze the effective, qp-conserving Lindbladian in the sectors with zero to two qps. We show how the Ising interaction renormalizes the decay rates of elementary spin-flip excitations and provides the microscopic mechanism for a competition between coherent interactions and dissipation. Our work establishes perturbative and non-perturbative continuous similarity transformations as a versatile tool for deriving effective qp pictures of open quantum many-body systems in the thermodynamic limit.
summary:
开放量子多体系统通常由 Lindblad 主方程描述，但在热力学极限下处理 Lindblad 算子仍然是一个重大挑战。我们开发了一个框架，用于直接在热力学极限下构造有效的准粒子守恒 Lindbladian 算子。我们的方法将连续相似变换扩展到非厄米开放量子系统，并实现 Lindbladians 相对于准粒子 (qp) 数的系统块对角化。我们制定了两种互补的方法。第一个是投影连续相似变换 (pcst++)，将微扰连续酉变换推广到 Lindblad 算子，以便链接簇展开使我们能够获得无限系统的高阶级数展开。第二个是 deepCST，通过将相同的 qp 守恒生成器与微扰截断方案相结合，扩展了直接评估的增强型微扰连续酉变换，该方案直接在热力学极限下产生非微扰有效 Lindbladian 算子。

我们将 pcst++ 和 deepCST 应用于具有局部耗散的耗散横向场 Ising 链。我们关注低伊辛政权。我们通过将每个旋转分成两个站点来纯化 Lindbladian。一次旋转翻转对应于两个 qps。我们推导并分析了 qps 为零到两个扇区中有效的 qp 守恒 Lindbladian。我们展示了伊辛相互作用如何重新规范基本自旋翻转激发的衰减率，并为相干相互作用和耗散之间的竞争提供微观机制。我们的工作将微扰和非微扰连续相似变换作为一种通用工具，用于在热力学极限下导出开放量子多体系统的有效 qp 图片。

title: Spin squeezing by geometric focusing in vacuum Rabi oscillations
abstract: We show that vacuum Rabi oscillations can directly generate spin squeezing through geometric focusing on the Bloch sphere. Starting from a coherent spin state resonantly coupled to a cavity initially in the vacuum state, quantum fluctuations are focused by the curvature of the Bloch sphere as the collective spin approaches the atomic ground state, producing squeezing transverse to the direction of motion. The squeezing timescale is set by the collective Rabi frequency $t_s\sim 1/(g\sqrt{N})$. The optimal Wineland squeezing parameter scales as $\xi_{\rm opt}^2\propto N^{-1/3}$, which is an outcome of the competition between the geometric focusing effects and the cavity-field vacuum fluctuations. The squeezing remains robust against realistic dissipation. In the end, an application example of $^{171}$Yb is briefly discussed to show the feasibility of our protocol.
summary: 我们证明真空拉比振荡可以通过布洛赫球上的几何聚焦直接产生自旋挤压。从与最初处于真空状态的腔体共振耦合的相干自旋态开始，当集体自旋接近原子基态时，量子涨落通过布洛赫球的曲率聚焦，产生横向于运动方向的挤压。挤压时间尺度由集体拉比频率 $t_s\sim 1/(g\sqrt{N})$ 设置。最优的 Wineland 压缩参数尺度为 $\xi_{\rm opt}^2\propto N^{-1/3}$，这是几何聚焦效应和腔场真空涨落之间竞争的结果。挤压对于实际耗散仍然很强大。最后，简要讨论了 $^{171}$Yb 的应用示例，以展示我们协议的可行性。

title: Conditional validity of quantum event classifiers under collider systematics and quantum estimation uncertainty
abstract: Claims about a deployed quantum machine-learning classifier can fail when target data shift or when finite-shot quantum evaluation randomizes the model itself. We develop an information-conditional, fail-closed auditing framework that returns supported, refuted or unresolved verdicts with anytime-valid per-claim error control under a declared sampling protocol. On a Higgs-to-tau-tau collider benchmark, stable classifier metrics do not guarantee valid signal-strength inference: at the studied finite-template statistics, the fixed-template profile can lose coverage, even in shift-free controls, when its templates are estimated independently and template-statistical uncertainty is not modeled explicitly. Across 30 frozen finite-shot quantum-kernel deployments, every realized Gram matrix is propagated through refitting, calibration and threshold selection; in the primary raw pipeline these perturbations leave ranking nearly unchanged yet move thresholded target metrics by about 0.02, flipping ideal-anchored claims, and the diagonal-loading sensitivity decomposes differently. Matched classical controls remove apparent quantum-specific nominal-performance and sensing effects. We claim no quantum advantage.
summary:
当目标数据发生变化或有限样本量子评估使模型本身随机化时，有关已部署的量子机器学习分类器的声明可能会失败。我们开发了一个信息条件、失败关闭的审核框架，该框架可根据声明的采样协议返回支持的、反驳的或未解决的判决，并具有随时有效的每个索赔错误控制。在 Higgs-to-tau-tau 对撞机基准上，稳定的分类器度量不能保证有效的信号强度推断：在所研究的有限模板统计中，当独立估计其模板并且未明确建模模板统计不确定性时，即使在无移位控制中，固定模板轮廓也可能会丢失覆盖范围。在 30 个冻结的有限样本量子内核部署中，每个实现的 Gram 矩阵都通过重新拟合、校准和阈值选择来传播；在主要原始管道中，这些扰动使排名几乎保持不变，但将阈值目标指标移动了约 0.02，翻转了理想锚定的声明，并且对角线加载敏感性以不同的方式分解。匹配的经典控制消除了明显的量子特定标称性能和传感效应。

我们声称没有量子优势。

title: Variational preparation of thermofield double states for SYK models via multi-angle QAOA: sequential angle pruning for circuit reduction
abstract: Variational preparation of thermofield double (TFD) states can require deep quantum circuits, particularly for interacting many-body systems. Reducing these circuits while retaining high fidelity is therefore crucial for TFD-state preparation on noisy quantum processors. We study this problem by applying the multi-angle quantum approximate optimization algorithm (ma-QAOA) to TFD-state preparation and introducing two top-down sequential angle-pruning algorithms. Starting from the optimized initial ma-QAOA circuit, both algorithms sequentially remove Pauli-string evolutions with small optimized angles and reoptimize the remaining parameters after each removal. We apply these algorithms to Gaussian and binary Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) models in both dense and sparse cases. We find that ma-QAOA prepares the target TFD states with high fidelity and that sequential small-angle pruning retains high fidelity while reducing the circuit depth, particularly at low temperature. Moreover, using the post-reoptimization cost in sequential small-angle pruning further improves the fidelity. For the binary sparse $N=10$ SYK model at $\beta=10$, $88.8\%$--$92.1\%$ of the nonlocal Pauli-string evolutions are removed while retaining an average fidelity of approximately $95\%$. Finally, we propose extensions of the sequential pruning algorithms toward quantum--classical hybrid implementation.
summary:
热场双态 (TFD) 的变分制备可能需要深度量子电路，特别是对于交互的多体系统。因此，在保持高保真度的同时减少这些电路对于噪声量子处理器上的 TFD 状态准备至关重要。我们通过将多角度量子近似优化算法（ma-QAOA）应用于 TFD 状态准备并引入两种自上而下的顺序角度剪枝算法来研究这个问题。从优化的初始ma-QAOA电路开始，两种算法依次去除具有小优化角度的泡利弦演化，并在每次去除后重新优化剩余参数。我们将这些算法应用于密集和稀疏情况下的高斯和二元 Sachdev--Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型。我们发现 ma-QAOA 以高保真度准备目标 TFD 状态，并且顺序小角度修剪在减少电路深度的同时保持高保真度，特别是在低温下。此外，在顺序小角度剪枝中使用重新优化后的成本进一步提高了保真度。

对于 $\beta=10$ 处的二元稀疏 $N=10$ SYK 模型，非局部泡利弦演化的 $88.8\%$--$92.1\%$ 被删除，同时保留大约 $95\%$ 的平均保真度。最后，我们提出将顺序剪枝算法扩展到量子经典混合实现。

title: A quantum oracle separation between QMA(2) and QMA
abstract: We find a quantum oracle relative to which $\mathsf{QMA} \neq \mathsf{QMA}(2)$. As a consequence, we resolve the no-disentanglers conjecture of Watrous: for every $\epsilon+\delta<1$, any $(\epsilon,\delta)$-disentangler requires input size exponential in the number of output qubits. Our proof combines the unitarily invariant polynomial method of She and Yuen (ITCS '23) with a new construction based on the symmetric and antisymmetric subspace projectors, reducing the $\mathsf{QMA}$ lower bound to the approximate degree of $\mathrm{OR}$.
summary: 我们找到了一个相对于 $\mathsf{QMA} \neq \mathsf{QMA}(2)$ 的量子预言。因此，我们解决了 Watrous 的无解缠器猜想：对于每个 $\epsilon+\delta<1$，任何 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-解缠器需要输入大小与输出量子位数量呈指数关系。我们的证明将 She 和 Yuen (ITCS '23) 的酉不变多项式方法与基于对称和反对称子空间投影仪的新构造相结合，将 $\mathsf{QMA}$ 下界减少到 $\mathrm{OR}$ 的近似度。
